enemy.danger.giant_rolling_stone: Unleashes a chain of regular Slays on round 5.
enemy.danger.giant_rolling_log: Unleashes a chain of Sure Slays on round 5.
enemy.danger.mihuan_xiao_shou: Its Pan Flute continuously widens damage differences. Manage your HP carefully.
enemy.danger.heavy_armor_guard: If left alive too long, its Heavy Hammer resolves all damage dealt before round 8.
enemy.danger.gunner: Multiple Gunners take turns attacking and keep pressure on you.
enemy.danger.wo_long_collective: After Stargazing, it may play several high-damage Slay attacks in a row.
enemy.danger.cold_guard: Uses Freeze to limit your actions.
enemy.danger.boss_tyrant: The Tyrant Crown makes Feather Guards immune to damage. Defeat the Tyrannical Ruler first. Below half HP, its Collapse reverses and it continually recovers HP; Wine Pool and Divine Brew provide a major Mana advantage.
enemy.danger.giant_pus_sac: The first time it reaches 0 HP, it recovers to 1 HP and gains Imminent Explosion. Next round it deals 40% of its maximum HP; only Negate, a Peach shield, or a Wine shield can block it, and it keeps fighting afterward.
enemy.danger.huang_yi_zhi_zhu: Carries Thunder Strike and Yellow Sky: a Dodge or shield that blocks its attack triggers a 10-point thunder counterattack; any thunder damage applies Lightning. Its Conductor Armor reduces thunder damage taken by 75%, so prioritize Thunder Slay.
enemy.danger.yellow_turban_devotee: At round start, Electric Shackle deals 1 thunder damage to itself and triggers Devotion: gain 2 Frenzy stacks, recover 5 HP, and take 10% less damage this round. Eliminate it early before Frenzy stacks grow.
enemy.danger.giant_mech_rat: Adds 1 Plague stack to you each round. At 10 stacks it deals 10 true Poison damage and removes 10 stacks; healing removes 5 stacks. Do not let the fight drag on.
enemy.danger.rat_king: Adds 1 Plague stack each round. Its Plague Staff makes regular Slays add 10 true Poison damage and 10 Plague stacks; its Tyrant Crown doubles all damage it takes. Finish it quickly before Plague reaches 10 stacks.
enemy.danger.corpse_collector: Its Rusted Blue-Steel Sword grants all Slay attacks +5 damage. With Mana it heavily favors Sure Slay, especially when you are below 20 HP. Avoid a one-round burst.

codex.equip.flavor.vehicle_fmt: {0} uses a mechanical frame for movement and carrying capacity; assemble it before battle and equip it in a vehicle slot.
codex.equip.flavor.mount_fmt: {0} includes riding and equipment fixtures for battlefield movement; equip it in a mount slot.

equipment.accessory_discount_voucher.fla: A folded voucher covered in guild seals, with tiny authentication wires along its edge; present it to the merchant at checkout.
equipment.accessory_electric_shackle.fla: Metal restraints salvaged from an old prison device, with faint arcs jumping between their rings; they fasten to a wrist-armor port.
equipment.accessory_elf_dust.flavor: Fine silver dust sealed in a finger-sized vial rises with a soft glow when shaken; it is usually sprinkled into medicine or food.
equipment.accessory_gunpowder.flavor: Coarse powder sits in a wax-sealed leather pouch wrapped with damp-proof cloth and a short fuse; ignite it quickly and keep clear.
equipment.accessory_mi_jiang.flavor: Amber nectar fills a small ceramic bottle, carrying the sweet scent of herbs and pollen; remove the stopper to drink it directly.
equipment.accessory_pan_xiao.flavor: Metal pipes of different lengths are fixed to a dark frame bearing a ruler's crest; equip it and blow across the pipes to activate it.
equipment.accessory_paralysis_device.fla: A palm-sized pulse unit assembled from old chips and copper wire emits a low hum when its side switch is pressed.
equipment.accessory_poison.flavor: Dark green liquid is sealed in a double-walled vial marked with a skull; it is normally brushed onto a weapon's edge.
equipment.accessory_sprouting_bonsai.fla: A stubborn sprout grows from a rusted iron pot, its roots tangled through discarded circuits; carry it gently and keep it watered.
equipment.accessory_night_vision_goggles: The lenses are etched with dense rangefinding marks; once a target is locked, they track its outline automatically until it falls.
equipment.armor_stealth_module.flavor: It bends light around the wearer, quietly erasing them from the battlefield—until they pull the trigger themselves.
equipment.accessory_time_hourglass.flavo: A transparent timing chamber enclosed by metal rings and wiring, with sand flowing upward; install it in an accessory port to activate it at battle start.
equipment.accessory_waterproof_module.fl: A sealed shell holds layered moisture barriers, with black gaskets covering every port; clip it over equipment seams to keep marsh water out.
equipment.armor_ban_jia.flavor: Heavy steel plates are riveted together with flexible seams at the shoulders and chest; wear it to protect vital areas.
equipment.armor_conductor.flavor: Thin copper plates form channels across the armor and connect to a coil on the back; its grounding pin must be locked before use.
equipment.armor_gang_dun.flavor: A broad shield pressed from layered alloys bears repair welds and old impact pits; brace it with the two grips on its inner face.
equipment.armor_ice_blue.flavor: Pale blue plates of cryogenic alloy vent white mist around each joint; an insulated lining keeps the biting cold off the wearer.
equipment.armor_iron_heavy.flavor: Iron Guard plate covers the chest and shoulders, its heavy rivets giving it the outline of a wall; mechanical clasps are needed to put it on.
equipment.armor_scale.flavor: Small metal scales overlap across a leather backing and rasp softly in motion; tighten the belt to fit the protection close to the body.
equipment.armor_tengjia.flavor: Old vines soaked in tung oil form light armor panels still marked by southern battlefields; leather cords secure them around the torso.
equipment.armor_tycoon.flavor: Gold-trimmed armor made from costly alloys bears a removable coin emblem on the chest; its owners often hide ledgers in the lining.
equipment.barbarian_tooth.flavor: A huge beast fang sharpened to an edge and bound with red-and-black tribal cord can serve as either a charm or a stabbing weapon.
equipment.benevolent_king.flavor: Heavy bracers bear the wrathful face of a guardian king; layered plates meet to form a solid barrier when both arms close.
equipment.big_bone_club.flavor: A complete leg bone from an unknown giant beast, with the thick joint wrapped into a grip; it takes both hands to swing steadily.
equipment.blue_steel_sword.flavor: A restored blue-steel blade has a straight, clean edge, while an old manufacturing number remains hidden beneath its simple guard.
equipment.boss_mysterious_potion.flavor: An unlabeled heavy syringe holds dark red liquid that slowly turns by itself; its injector is built for a single use.
equipment.broken_emotional_component.fla: A cracked synthetic chip still emits weak pulses, its surface preserving an emotional waveform no reader can decode.
equipment.chip_attack.flavor: A red wafer etched with blade-shaped circuits fits a universal chip socket and gives a short calibration tone when powered.
equipment.clamp_exoskeleton.flavor: Paired hydraulic clamps at each joint mirror the wearer's limbs; once locked, the frame moves heavily but remains steady.
equipment.curse_blade.flavor: Dark red sigils that cannot be polished away cover this black blade, which trembles near wounds; insulating cloth wraps its hilt.
equipment.dan.flavor: A dark red pill rests in a cloud-patterned porcelain case, releasing a heavy herbal scent with a trace of metal when opened.
equipment.equip_stinky_green.flavor: Greenish caps crowd a sealed culture box while slime crawls down its walls; putting on a mask before opening it is wise.
equipment.equip_stinky_red.flavor: Tiny pores cover blood-red caps that spray pungent spores when shaken; the fungi are normally carried inside their culture jar.
equipment.equip_stinky_yellow.flavor: Wax-yellow mushrooms smell almost like rotting meat, their roots wired into a nutrient box to stop them spreading.
equipment.equipment_war_drum.flavor: Hide stretches across a reinforced metal drum marked with an old legion number; strap it at the waist and strike it with a short beater.
equipment.expansion_chip.flavor: A broad blue expansion board has several spare ports and exceeds standard chip dimensions; installation requires an extra bracket.
equipment.forgotten_stone.flavor: This gray-white stone has no natural grain, and details seen while holding it soon slip from memory; it is usually kept in a lead box.
equipment.accessory_golden_statue.flavor: A weighty statue of solid gold has features worn smooth by age, with narrow incense holes cut into its base.
equipment.moon_gem.flavor: A crescent of cold light hangs within this milky gem and never changes with the surroundings; set it in jewelry or carry it in hand.
equipment.mount_chi_tu.flavor: A crimson warhorse wears light mechanical barding, with fiery filaments threaded through its mane; its saddle is reinforced for charges.
equipment.mount_mu_niu_liu_ma.flavor: Gears and cables drive this wooden pack automaton across rough ground, while a back rack secures luggage and weapons.
equipment.treasure_donkey.flavor: A grey donkey wears an old mechanical pack saddle loaded with sealed batteries and copper cargo boxes; a crude power gauge hangs from its reins.
equipment.mount_white_horse.flavor: A snow-white military horse wears a plain silver saddle and moves with a light, steady gait; long campaigns have worn its reins smooth.
equipment.mysterious_chip.flavor: This black chip of unknown origin has no standard connector, and its markings shift with the viewing angle; only ancient devices accept it.
equipment.rust_blue_steel_sword.flavor: A corroded longsword whose edge still shows a blue metallic sheen, fitted with a simple guard; grip the hilt for close-range slashes.
equipment.rust_shield.flavor: Corrosion has darkened this round shield and dented its rim, but the frame remains whole; repaired straps make it barely usable.
equipment.rust_spear.flavor: Rust spots cover this short sword, whose old wooden grip is tightly wrapped in cloth; its moderate weight still suits cuts and thrusts.
equipment.rust_sword.flavor: A long spearhead has lost its shine, and rain has split the wooden shaft; gripping its midpoint keeps a thrust balanced.
equipment.silver_lion.flavor: A silver lion clasp bites onto the chest straps while mane-like plates spread toward the shoulders; a guardian inscription lines its underside.
equipment.soul_stone.flavor: Faint human shapes drift inside a translucent black stone, and distant whispers emerge when it nears the ear; talisman strips seal its cracks.
equipment.spring_essence.flavor: Clear spring essence rests in a narrow crystal bottle always beaded with cool mist; shake the glow at its base before drinking or pouring.
equipment.statue_core.flavor: A spherical core removed from a giant statue still turns slowly inside its shell, which is covered in worn control symbols.
equipment.tiger_tally.flavor: A black-bronze tiger tally separates cleanly down the center, its teeth fitting perfectly; in old armies, only its bearer could command troops.
equipment.true_blue_steel_sword.flavor: The reforged blue-steel sword shines with a cold blue cast and not a trace of rust, while an old core hums inside its grip.
equipment.tyrant_crown.flavor: Sharp iron points joined by dark-gold rivets surround this crown, whose inner ring bears stains that never wash away; it grips the brow tightly.
equipment.weapon_vampiric_fang.flavor: A curved fang has been hollowed into a needle blade and linked to a tiny reservoir; a warm pulse travels through it when it pierces a target.
equipment.vehicle_di_lu.flavor: This gray-white warhorse bears a striking tear mark on its brow and light armor over vital areas; a special saddle steadies its rider in chaos.
equipment.vehicle_han_xue_bao_ma.flavor: A tall western horse has muscles taut as bowstrings and sweat with a red sheen; its broad saddle and leg guards suit long sprints.
equipment.vehicle_zhua_huang_fei_dian.fl: Light plates cover the hooves of this golden horse, making its gallop nearly silent; black-gold fittings reinforce the tack.
equipment.weapon_fire_pattern_silver_spe: Red patterns like flowing flame run through a bright silver spearhead, with a heat channel hidden in the shaft for repeated thrusts.
equipment.weapon_gu_ding_dao.flavor: This fully restored ancient broadblade has a square heavy spine and forward balance, favoring weighty cuts driven from the waist.
equipment.weapon_heavy_hammer.flavor: A solid hammerhead cast from scrap steel is bound by crack-resistant bands, while a weighted pommel helps recover after each swing.
equipment.weapon_hejin_jian.flavor: An industrial alloy sword has a uniform edge and modular guard, allowing damaged fittings to be replaced quickly.
equipment.weapon_hejin_mao.flavor: A light alloy shaft carries a narrow armor-piercing point and a wrapped grip, built for quick straight thrusts.
equipment.weapon_hook_chain.flavor: A barbed metal hook connects to a long chain and retrieval reel, allowing it to be hauled back rapidly after a throw.
equipment.weapon_jet_mace.flavor: A crude jet is fixed to the mace's tail with exposed fuel lines along the grip; ignition drives the heavy head through a swing.
equipment.weapon_long_bow.flavor: Layered limbs form a long arc and a metal-fiber string holds the draw; the bow needs a full pull for a steady shot.
equipment.weapon_plague_staff.flavor: A cloudy culture chamber crowns the twisted staff as green mist circulates through its tubes; damaged seals must be avoided.
equipment.weapon_qing_long_yan_yue_dao.f: A green dragon coils along the enormous crescent blade, whose long shaft sweeps a broad arc; its weight demands both hands.
equipment.weapon_reaper.flavor: A folding pole supports a curved mechanical scythe whose edge vibrates at low speed when active; unfold it for broad sweeps.
equipment.weapon_rust_gu_ding_dao.flavor: Rust covers this ancient broadblade, though its thick spine keeps its original shape; a newly wrapped grip makes it usable again.
equipment.weapon_short_bow.flavor: Wood and old metal laminates form a compact bow suited to quickly nocking and firing in confined spaces.
equipment.weapon_speculator_blade.flavor: Changing price marks cover a narrow blade with a guard shaped like turning tokens; a tiny ledger hides inside its sheath.
equipment.weapon_thunder_spear.flavor: Blue-white discharge needles flank the spearhead and carry current along an insulated shaft; tighten the charge ring before use.
equipment.weapon_true_gu_ding_dao.flavor: Reforged in blue flame, this ancient blade carries molten dark-red lines through its steel while preserving the old stamp on its heavy spine.
equipment.weapon_zhang_ba_she_mao.flavor: Twin serpentine edges coil around the spearpoint and grip marks cover the long shaft; shifting hand positions enables thrusts and sweeps.
equipment.wine_pouch.flavor: A hard-wearing leather pouch holds strong wine, its wooden stopper tied to the neck; hang it at the waist for a quick drink.
equipment.witch_scalp.flavor: Dry hair clings to a piece of rune-cut hide that still reeks of incense; it is normally wrapped in waxed cloth for ritual use.
equipment.xian_hao.flavor: White bristles bound to a jade handle leave pale gold writing without ink; the brush belongs in a spirit-sealing case when unused.
equipment.xian_niang.flavor: Clear immortal wine rests in a cloud-patterned jade flask, releasing thin mist when opened; its mild fragrance lingers for hours.
equipment.yellow_talisman.flavor: Complex vermilion circuits cover a yellow paper charm with thin metal tabs at its corners; tuck it inside armor to carry it safely.
equipment.zhuge_crossbow.flavor: A linked magazine and geared trigger sit on this wooden crossbow, loading the string as the mechanism cycles; it can be operated one-handed.
equipment.zhuque_yushan.flavor: Crimson feathers unfold around metal ribs in the shape of a vermilion bird; each sweep stirs a wave of heated air.

skill.wushuang.name: Peerless
skill.wushuang.desc: All attack card final damage ×2. Applies to Slay, Fire Slay, Thunder Slay, Sure Slay, and all future attack cards.
skill.biyue.name: Lunar Veil
skill.biyue.desc: [Passive] After battle starts, gain 1 resource at the end of the first turn; then gain 1 resource every two complete turns thereafter. Uses an independent counter unaffected by extra turns, skipped turns, or end-turn effects.
skill.bizhong.name: Sure Strike
skill.bizhong.desc: Ma Chao's signature skill, representing his exclusive move [Sure Strike]: costs 1 fee, deals 10 damage to the target, and cannot be blocked by [Dodge] — every strike lands true.
factionfate.reveal.title: This Battle's Faction Fate
damage_preview.tooltip.title: Final Damage Breakdown
damage_preview.tooltip.uncertain_note: Final damage if this attack lands; Dodge, Counter-Trick, and type-counter cancellation are resolved during the exchange.
damage_preview.warning.tuxi_steal: On hit, also triggers Petty Theft: steals 1 fee from the target (not counted in the damage number).
skill.lianying.name: Chain Camp
skill.lianying.desc: Whenever your fee changes from non-zero to 0, gain the Chain Camp status: your first ordinary Slay next turn is free (if unused, it expires at the end of that turn). Before it can trigger again, your fee must first leave 0 and then return to 0. Can trigger repeatedly within a battle.
skill.longdan.name: Dragon Gall
skill.longdan.desc: After successfully defending against an attack with Dodge, you may activate after the battle phase. Choose Slay, Fire Slay, or Thunder Slay and continue resolving this exchange as that card; Slay is free, Fire Slay and Thunder Slay each cost 1 resource.
skill.qingnang.name: Divine Medicine
skill.qingnang.desc: Peach costs 1 resource. A Peach that successfully blocks damage still heals. Peach healing may raise current HP above max HP, but the excess lasts only for the current battle.
skill.keji.name: Self-Restraint
skill.keji.desc: Resources do not reset between stages and can accumulate up to 15.
skill.manzu.name: Savage
skill.manzu.desc: Start with an extra Barbarian Invasion in your deck; the cost of Barbarian Invasion is reduced to 2 for this run (affects Meng Huo only).
skill.guanxing.name: Stargaze
skill.guanxing.desc: Add a Stargaze card (0 cost) to your play area. After using it, enter Stargaze mode: the card you play next turn is recorded and then replayed automatically for the following two turns (resource-free; targets may be changed). Stargaze is immune to Plunder.
skill.luoyi.name: Bare-Armed
skill.luoyi.desc: Your attacks ignore action defenses such as Dodge and Nullify, while shields can still block them. When you play an attack, incoming damage that round is ×2; that attack is treated as playing Fee but grants no Mana, and cannot cancel, counter, or ignore enemy damage.
skill.jigu.name: War Drum
skill.jigu.desc: Triggers the reaction bar whenever you take actual damage, until activated once this battle. When activated, enter War Drum mode (3 turns): all incoming damage is reduced to zero, and after each hit you deal, immediately restore all HP.
skill.qianxun.name: Humility
skill.qianxun.desc: Immune to Plunder (cannot be targeted by it). All non-attack tricks (Wine / Peach / Plunder / Nullify / Stargaze) cost 0.5 less (minimum 0).
skill.luoshen.name: Luoshen
skill.luoshen.desc: [Passive] Gain increasing resources for consecutive [Fee]-spending turns: 1 resource on the 1st turn, 2 on the 2nd consecutive turn, etc. If you did not play [Fee] this turn, halve your resources at the start of next turn (rounded down; does not trigger at 2 or fewer resources).
skill.wansha.name: Total Kill
skill.wansha.desc: [Passive] Whenever any character recovers HP through healing, deal true damage equal to the amount healed (ignores armor, damage reduction, and dodge; not attack damage). Does not trigger if actual healing is 0. Triggered by Peach, Wine, Elixir, Shattered Emotion component, enhanced Peach from Sprouting Bonsai, and all healing events.
skill.xuezhaixuechou.name: Blood Vendetta
skill.xuezhaixuechou.desc: [Passive] After you take damage, deal true damage equal to the damage received to all enemies (ignores armor, damage reduction, Vine Armor, Scale Armor, and dodge; not attack damage). This damage does not trigger counter-attacks, Dragon Gall, Stargaze, Wine bonuses, or any on-hit effects, and cannot trigger Blood Vendetta again.
skill.xuezhaixuechou_near_death.name: Blood Vendetta
skill.xuezhaixuechou_near_death.desc: [Passive] The first time this unit is brought to 0 or fewer HP, it does not die immediately; instead it enters a near-death state. On its next turn it deals true damage equal to 40% of its max HP to the player (ignores armor, dodge, and Nullify), then dies. Triggers at most once per battle.
skill.huaxing.name: Metamorph
skill.huaxing.desc: [Passive] Triggers at battle start. HP becomes equal to the player's current HP; copies all the player's skills and equipment (excluding chip bonuses); retains Metamorph and Celestial Hair; loses its own original attributes. Copying only happens once.
skill.pojun.name: Break Army
skill.pojun.desc: [Passive] When a Slay-type attack deals damage, if you have at least 0.5 Mana, play [Break Army] in the reaction bar. Lose 0.5 Mana to add one additional multiple of that Slay's damage. It is calculated separately and may repeat; each trigger adds one multiple rather than doubling exponentially.
skill.yicheng.name: Doubtful City
skill.yicheng.desc: [Passive] Whenever you lose resource in battle, heal 5 HP. Whenever you lose health, gain 0.25 resource; this can trigger multiple times per round.
skill.changzui.name: Chronic Drunk
skill.changzui.desc: [Passive] After using Wine, Wine stacks do not expire at turn end; they are only consumed when a Slay-type attack is launched.
skill.jihan.name: Permafrost
skill.jihan.desc: [Card Skill] [Active Skill] Unlock Ice Slay in your play area (cost 3; deals 10 damage and inflicts Freeze: the target can only spend resources next turn).
skill.jiuchi.name: Wine Pool
skill.jiuchi.desc: The first three Wine cards you play each turn are free.
skill.roulin.name: Flesh Forest
skill.roulin.desc: Whenever your attack misses, the target loses 0.5 resources. Triggers at most once per turn.
skill.benghuai.name: Collapse
skill.benghuai.desc: At the end of each turn: if HP is above 500, lose 10 HP; if HP is 500 or below, recover 10 HP.
skill.baonue.name: Brutality
skill.baonue.desc: When another Qun-faction character deals damage, gain 1 resource. Triggers at most once per turn.
skill.manzu_wang.name: Savage King
skill.manzu_wang.desc: Barbarian Invasion damage ×2; each time Barbarian Invasion hits an enemy, recover 5 HP and 0.5 resources.
skill.moon_gaze.name: Moon Gaze
skill.moon_gaze.desc: When battle reaches turn 15, the enemy gains Stun. When battle reaches turn 49, the enemy dies instantly. This death is a mechanic kill and cannot be negated by any effect.
skill.celestial_impact.name: Celestial Impact
skill.celestial_impact.desc: Replace your attack card with Celestial Impact. It is a 1-cost Nanman Invasion that deals 10 damage to all enemies.
skill.yingxi.name: Shadow Strike
skill.yingxi.desc: Add Shadow Strike (variable cost: 0/1/2) to your play area. After use, enter Shadow Strike mode (3 turns): full invincibility, crowd-control immunity, and immunity to Steal; only Shadow Slay and Lurk remain in your play area. Shadow Slay costs 1 resource, inherits Sure Slay properties, and can only be used once per Shadow Strike period. If it hits and deals damage, next Shadow Strike costs 0. If 3 turns pass without attacking, regain 1 resource; if the attack deals no damage, next use costs 2.
skill.ruyingsuixing.name: Like Shadow
skill.ruyingsuixing.desc: ① Cannot gain additional max HP (current HP can still be restored). ② Event HP loss is nullified. ③ Whenever any unit on the field takes actual damage, all characters' resources are reset to 1. ④ If damage dealt by Huang Yueying is fully absorbed by a Peach / Wine / Benevolence shield, gain 1 resource.
skill.zhoutai_buqu.name: Indomitable
skill.zhoutai_buqu.desc: [Passive] Whenever your HP drops to 0 or below, roll 1D6. On a 5 or 6, gain 1 resource and restore HP to 1. The first failed roll each battle also grants 1 resource and restores HP to 1; later failed rolls proceed through the normal near-death/revival process.
skill.zhoutai_fenji.name: Fervor
skill.zhoutai_fenji.desc: [Passive] Whenever your HP drops to 0 or below and you enter near-death resolution, permanently gain +2 fixed damage for attacking tricks (lasts for this Run, persists across battles/chapters, resets on a new Run).
skill.pangtong_nirvana.name: Nirvana
skill.pangtong_nirvana.desc: [Passive] The first time this battle your HP drops to 0 or below, become invincible this turn and next turn, revive at full HP, and reset both sides' resources to 1. Triggers only once per battle.
skill.pangtong_iron_chain.name: Iron Chain
skill.pangtong_iron_chain.desc: [Active][Card] Adds Iron Chain to the action bar. Gain 1 Shield on use; starting next turn, all living units are linked and the first damage each turn is shared with every other unit. Breaking the shield does not sever the link.
skill.tianji.name: Heavenly Secrets
skill.tianji.desc: Stargaze upgrade. When you use Stargaze, immediately gain 1 resource (Stargaze's normal cost still applies).
skill.dongzhuo_benghuai.name: Dong Zhuo's Collapse
skill.dongzhuo_benghuai.desc: Starting from turn 2, at the start of every turn: if HP is above 1/4 of max HP, lose 20 HP; if HP is at or below 1/4 of max HP, recover 1/16 of max HP (rounded down).
skill.keji_unlimited.name: Self-Restraint Unlimited
skill.keji_unlimited.desc:
Authorization verified. Resource cap protocol lifted.
1. Resource cap raised to 20 (replaces Self-Restraint's cap of 15).
2. Each 1 resource you hold increases damage dealt by 10% (up to +200%, i.e. ×3).
3. Immune to Plunder.
4. Retains all original Self-Restraint functions (resources do not reset).
skill.rende.name: Benevolence
skill.rende.desc: Gain 2 Benevolence Shield stacks at turn start. Each stack blocks one full damage instance and expires at turn end.
skill.taoyuan_jiyi.name: Peach Garden Memory
skill.taoyuan_jiyi.desc: The first time the shared HP pool drops below 150, trigger once: restore 100 shared HP.
skill.wusheng.name: Wusheng
skill.wusheng.desc: Guan Yu's Slay-type attacks deal 5 additional base damage.
skill.yijue.name: Righteousness Cut
skill.yijue.desc: If the player took damage last turn, Guan Yu's Slay-type damage is ×2 this turn.
skill.paoxiao.name: Warcry
skill.paoxiao.desc: Each time a Slay-type attack hits and deals damage, Zhang Fei's Slay base damage permanently increases by 5 (cumulative within this battle).
skill.paoxiao_player.name: Warcry
skill.paoxiao_player.desc: [Passive] Your Slay-type damage grows stronger during battle. Each Slay you use increases that battle's Slay base damage by 5 starting next turn (N Slays used → +N×5 damage). The in-battle accumulation resets after the battle; each battle won permanently increases Slay damage by 5 (retained for this run).
skill.zibao.name: Self-Destruct
skill.zibao.desc: [Passive] The first time HP reaches 0 or below, restore to 1 HP. Next turn, deal damage equal to 40% of max HP to the enemy. Only Nullify, Peach shields, or Wine shields can block it. Triggers once per battle.
skill.leiji.name: Lightning Strike
skill.leiji.desc: When an enemy's attack card fails to deal damage to you (blocked by Dodge, shield, Nullify, etc.), immediately deal 10 Thunder-type damage to the attacker.
skill.huangtian.name: Yellow Heaven
skill.huangtian.desc: When an enemy takes Thunder damage, create Lightning on that enemy. At the start of each turn, Lightning has a 10% chance to strike for 20 Thunder damage; otherwise it transfers between Zhang Jiao and a random enemy. Its damage benefits from offensive Trick damage bonuses.
skill.illusion.name: Illusion
skill.illusion.desc: When successfully hit by a Slay-type attack, record that card type and become fully immune to attacks of the same type. The record updates when hit by a different type. Updates only when actual damage is dealt; blocked by Dodge or shields does not update it.
skill.slime.name: Slime
skill.slime.desc: After successfully blocking an enemy Slay-type attack, apply Slime Weakness to the attacker: their next attack card deals ×0.5 damage; consumed in one use, non-stackable.
skill.boss_healer_passive.name: Mysterious Potion
skill.boss_healer_passive.desc: [Passive] When HP, including temporary HP, reaches 120, enter Enhanced State: Slay attacks become Sure-Slay and deal +5 damage. Triggers once per battle.
skill.boss_traitor_combo.name: Combo
skill.boss_traitor_combo.desc: [Passive] 2 consecutive attack turns → enter Combo State: +5 attack damage, prefer Fire/Thunder Slay. 2 consecutive non-attack turns → exit Combo State.
skill.budao.name: Indomitable
skill.budao.desc: [Passive] The first time HP drops to 0, do not die: restore to 1 HP, gain 2 Resource, and become immune to all damage next turn. Triggers once per battle.
skill.qianxin_devotion.name: Devotion
skill.qianxin_devotion.desc: [Passive] When the holder takes Thunder-type damage, immediately gain 2 Frenzy Buff stacks and recover 5 HP. Each Frenzy stack multiplies final attack damage by ×1.5 (stacking multiplicatively); stacks decrease by 1 at the end of each turn. No limit on trigger count; each Thunder damage event triggers independently.
skill.chang_yin_jolly_drinking.name: Jolly Drinking
skill.chang_yin_jolly_drinking.desc: [Passive] When the holder uses Wine, all friendly characters on the field immediately gain 1 additional Wine Buff stack (damage bonus only, no Wine shield). Includes the holder and all allies.
skill.plague_pestilence.name: Pestilence
skill.plague_pestilence.desc: [Passive] At the start of each turn, add 1 Pestilence Debuff stack to all enemies. When stacks reach 10, trigger immediately: deal 10 true Poison damage and clear the 10 stacks that triggered this. Receiving healing clears 5 Pestilence stacks.
skill.meihuo_charm.name: Bewitch
skill.meihuo_charm.desc: [Active Skill] [Card Skill] Add Bewitch (1 cost, targeted trick) to your play area. Choose one enemy and gain 1 Bewitch Shield that blocks the next valid damage dealt to you. The target may only play Fee next turn even if the shield is broken. Non-stackable. Usable at most 3 times per battle.
skill.si_di_enemy_read.name: Dead Zone
skill.si_di_enemy_read.desc: [Passive] Only compares your card with the currently locked enemy; cards played by other enemies are ignored. On a matching category: Resource → gain 1 extra resource; both Attack → the locked enemy's attack is nullified; Peach → double your healing and cancel their Peach; Wine → double your Wine bonus and cancel their Wine; Dodge / Nullify → gain 1 resource; Plunder → cancel their Plunder while yours still resolves.
skill.tuxi.name: Raid
skill.tuxi.desc: [Active] [Card Skill] Start with the 2-cost trick Raid. Resolve it against each target using Nanman Invasion rules, then resolve Steal after resource cards against each target that took damage. If a target has no Mana at that time, the user gains 1 Mana.
skill.yingzi.name: Heroic Bearing
skill.yingzi.desc: Replaces Fire Slay in the action bar with the exclusive trick card Fire Attack.
skill.yeyan.name: Blazing Legacy
skill.yeyan.desc: Whenever you deal Fire damage to an enemy, it gains 2 stacks of Weakness.
skill.jiang.name: Rally
skill.jiang.desc: When your Slay-type card hits an enemy, immediately deal extra normal Slay damage equal to 20% of your max HP to the target, then recover 5 HP. If the Slay-type card fails to deal damage, immediately lose 33% of your current HP, then gain 1 resource.
skill.hunzi.name: Soul Form
skill.hunzi.desc: After actually losing HP to damage, if current HP is below 50% of current max HP and current max HP is above 20, reduce max HP by 20% plus 10, then heal to the new maximum. This can trigger repeatedly until max HP reaches 20 or less. Max HP returns to its battle-start value after battle.
skill.wuku.name: Armory
skill.wuku.desc: Counts every piece of equipment in your bag (equipped or not): (1) each Defense item grants +4/+8/+12/+16 max HP by rarity; (2) each Attack item grants +2/+4/+6/+8 flat bonus damage to Sha-type and damaging trick cards by rarity; (3) each Accessory grants +0.2 extra fee whenever you play [Fee]; (4) each Vehicle grants +0.5 starting fee at the start of battle. All of these are recalculated live from your bag's contents; items do not need to be equipped.
equipment.armor_ban_jia.name: Plate Armor
equipment.armor_ban_jia.desc: Heavy steel armor that effectively protects the wearer. Gain 15 HP immediately upon equipping.
equipment.silver_lion.name: Silver Lion
equipment.silver_lion.desc: Gain 20 max HP. The first time you die this run, your HP resets to 10. Triggers once only.
equipment.rust_shield.name: Rusty Shield
equipment.benevolent_king.name: Benevolent King
equipment.benevolent_king.desc: The first time you take damage this run, negate that damage. Triggers once only.
equipment.rust_blue_steel_sword.name: Blue Steel Sword (Rusty)
equipment.rust_blue_steel_sword.desc: All Slay damage +5. Applies to Slay, Fire Slay, Thunder Slay, and True Slay.
equipment.blue_steel_sword.name: Blue Steel Sword
equipment.blue_steel_sword.desc: All Slay damage +8. Applies to Slay, Fire Slay, Thunder Slay, and True Slay.
equipment.rust_sword.name: Rusty Spear
equipment.rust_spear.name: Rusty Sword
equipment.rust_spear.desc: Slay hits all enemies. Does not affect Fire Slay / Thunder Slay / Storm Slay.
equipment.yellow_talisman.name: Yellow Talisman
equipment.yellow_talisman.desc: At the start of battle, starting Mana is fixed at 2.
equipment.wine_pouch.name: Wine Pouch
equipment.wine_pouch.desc: The first Wine card played this run costs 0. Only affects the first Wine card.
equipment.tiger_tally.name: Tiger Tally
equipment.tiger_tally.desc: After the 4th combat round ends, gain 1 Mana. Triggers once only.
equipment.dan.name: Elixir
equipment.dan.desc: This elixir doesn't seem to be taken orally — touching it causes it to shift into strange forms.
equipment.mysterious_chip.name: Mysterious Chip
equipment.mysterious_chip.desc: A chip of unknown origin. Its surface flickers with unrecognizable symbols. It seems to be waiting for something.
equipment.equip_stinky_red.name: Stinky Mushroom · Red
equipment.equip_stinky_red.desc:
Crimson mycelium constantly releases spores that dull the nervous system.
You become sluggish, and so do your enemies.
Your final damage dealt ×0.75. Final damage taken ×0.75.
equipment.equip_stinky_yellow.name: Stinky Mushroom · Yellow
equipment.equip_stinky_yellow.desc:
The yellow cap ravenously devours all nearby energy.
Every power system, friend or foe, falls into deficit at the start of battle.
At the start of each battle, both the player's and every enemy's starting mana is forced to -1.
equipment.equip_stinky_green.name: Stinky Mushroom · Green
equipment.equip_stinky_green.desc:
Green spores constantly corrode skin and armor alike.
All wounds rapidly worsen.
Final damage taken by all units ×1.25.
equipment.armor_tengjia.name: Rattan Armor
equipment.armor_tengjia.desc: Gain 10 max HP. When hit by Physical damage (Slay, Nanman Invasion, Arrow Barrage, etc.), final damage is halved (×0.5). When hit by any Fire-type damage (Fire Slay, Fire-Thunder Slay, etc.), final damage is doubled (×2). Both effects resolve in the final multiplier zone after all additive bonuses.
equipment.armor_scale.name: Scale Armor
equipment.armor_scale.desc: Gain 10 max HP. Each time you take damage, the final damage is capped at 15 (applied after all additive and multiplicative bonuses).
equipment.mount_white_horse.name: White Horse
equipment.mount_white_horse.desc: The first Slay played each battle costs 0. Only affects Slay, not Fire Slay, Thunder Slay, or True Slay. Resets each battle; does not clear on scene change.
equipment.vehicle_di_lu.name: Dilu Horse
equipment.vehicle_di_lu.desc: Negate the first damage you receive in this battle. If the bearer is Liu Bei: Benevolence restores 20 HP instead of 10.
equipment.vehicle_zhua_huang_fei_dian.de: In this battle, the first attack card that costs Mana costs 0 instead.
equipment.vehicle_han_xue_bao_ma.name: Bloodsweat Horse
equipment.vehicle_han_xue_bao_ma.desc: At the start of battle, gain 20 temporary HP.
equipment.weapon_hook_chain.name: Hook Chain
equipment.weapon_hook_chain.desc: Pursuit and drag. If two consecutive Slay cards both miss, both sides take 5 true damage.
equipment.armor_iron_heavy.name: Iron Guard Heavy Armor
equipment.armor_iron_heavy.desc: Just looking at it conveys immense weight. Gain 20 max HP. Each battle: the first time you take more than 20 damage in a single hit, that damage is reduced to 0. Triggers once only; resets each battle.
equipment.weapon_jet_mace.name: Jet-Propelled Mace
equipment.weapon_jet_mace.desc: Jet propulsion unleashes tremendous burst power. The first attack each battle deals triple damage. Triggers once only; resets each battle. Applies to all attack cards.
equipment.weapon_heavy_hammer.name: Heavy Hammer
equipment.weapon_heavy_hammer.desc: A massive imperial weapon engraved with intricate patterns and a lion-head hammerhead. Every 8 rounds, deal half of the damage dealt to enemies during the preceding 8 rounds.
equipment.equipment_war_drum.name: War Drum
equipment.equipment_war_drum.desc: Beating it releases waves of tangible energy. After the first attack card played in this battle, all attack cards gain +5 base damage starting from the next round. The effect persists as long as at least one attack card is played each round; otherwise it is removed immediately.
equipment.soul_stone.name: Soul Stone
equipment.soul_stone.desc: A stone radiating mysterious light. When sold: in addition to gold, randomly gain one Chip (Attack / Defense / Knowledge, 33% each).
equipment.curse_blade.name: Curse Blade
equipment.curse_blade.desc: It has latched onto you now. Multiplies current Curse stacks by 5; subsequent Curse gains are also ×5. Every 5 Curse stacks increases your damage by 0.1×. Gain 2 Curse stacks per battle while equipped. Curse no longer decays automatically after battles. Cannot be sold.
equipment.big_bone_club.name: Giant Bone Club
equipment.big_bone_club.desc: A bone this large — what creature could it have belonged to? Your Slay-type cards deal +9 damage. When they successfully hit an enemy, apply 1 stack of Stun to that enemy.
equipment.forgotten_stone.name: Stone of Forgetting
equipment.forgotten_stone.desc:
Touching it makes you feel as though you too have been forgotten.
Round 1 of battle: immune to any form of damage.
Rounds 2-3: all damage taken is reduced by 50% (rounded down).
Returns to normal from round 4 onward.
equipment.statue_core.name: Statue Core
equipment.statue_core.desc: It spins ceaselessly within the statue. For the first 3 successful attacks this battle, deal 50% splash damage to up to 2 additional enemies.
equipment.spring_essence.name: Spring Essence
equipment.spring_essence.desc: Condensed from an eternal spring. Immune to combat debuffs. When sold: gain 2 Forage.
equipment.witch_scalp.name: Witch's Scalp
equipment.witch_scalp.desc: Even separated from its body, it still whispers in your ear. When sold: gain Attack Chip ×1, Knowledge Chip ×1, Defense Chip ×1. Triggers once only.
equipment.xian_niang.name: Celestial Brew
equipment.xian_niang.desc: Wine costs -1 Mana. If Wine already costs 0, using Wine grants 1 Mana at end of round (once per round).
equipment.tyrant_crown.name: Tyrant's Crown
equipment.tyrant_crown.desc: While the bearer is alive, allies take no damage. All damage the bearer takes is ×2.
equipment.moon_gem.name: Moon Gem
equipment.moon_gem.desc: A burning star seems sealed within the gem. Gain the skill Celestial Impact and add it to your action bar.
equipment.weapon_thunder_spear.name: Thunder Spear
equipment.weapon_thunder_spear.desc: Lightning courses through its entire length — the real challenge is how to hold it. Thunder Slay costs 1 Mana (originally 2).
equipment.chip_attack.name: Attack Chip
equipment.chip_attack.desc: A chip etched with an attack-amplification matrix. All Slay damage +3.
equipment.clamp_exoskeleton.name: Clamping Mechanical Exoskeleton
equipment.clamp_exoskeleton.desc: A rigid exoskeleton that helps control enemies in battle. Gain 50 max HP. The first time HP drops to 50% or below: immediately use Pillage on the enemy, gain Wine Buff ×1, and enter Repair state (restore to full HP at the start of the next round). Triggers once per battle.
equipment.weapon_short_bow.name: Short Bow
equipment.weapon_short_bow.desc: A nimble short bow ideal for close-range harassment.
equipment.weapon_long_bow.name: Long Bow
equipment.weapon_long_bow.desc: Precise sniping — one shot, one kill.
equipment.weapon_rust_gu_ding_dao.name: Rusty Guding Blade
equipment.weapon_rust_gu_ding_dao.desc: Even rusted, its edge exploits an exhausted foe.
equipment.weapon_gu_ding_dao.name: Guding Blade
equipment.weapon_gu_ding_dao.desc: Its stroke hunts foes who have spent their strength.
equipment.weapon_true_gu_ding_dao.name: True Guding Blade
equipment.weapon_true_gu_ding_dao.desc:
Fire and thunder flow through a blade beyond ordinary forms.
Reforged by Xu Sheng in the Ancient Shu Furnace.
equipment.accessory_poison.name: Poison
equipment.accessory_poison.desc: Coat the blade with it — one cut and it's fatal.
equipment.accessory_gunpowder.name: Gunpowder
equipment.accessory_sprouting_bonsai.des: Seeing something so full of life lifts the spirit.
equipment.accessory_pan_xiao.name: Pan Flute
equipment.accessory_pan_xiao.desc:
The ruler's favorite instrument.
Its melodious tune constantly affects everyone on the battlefield.
equipment.accessory_paralysis_device.des: A compact tactical disruption device. At the start of battle, deal 5 true damage to every enemy three times.
equipment.accessory_elf_dust.name: Elf Dust
equipment.accessory_elf_dust.desc: Dust that glimmers with faint light. Your Peach healing amount is doubled.
equipment.accessory_waterproof_module.de: The sealed structure effectively blocks moisture. Max HP +10 and immune to [Wet].
equipment.boss_mysterious_potion.name: Mysterious Potion
equipment.boss_mysterious_potion.desc: An injection made for exceptionally strong monsters. When current HP, including temporary HP, is at least 120, ordinary Slay becomes Sure-Slay.
At current HP ≥120 including temporary HP, ordinary Slay becomes Sure-Slay.
equipment.golden_statue.name: Golden Statue
equipment.golden_statue.desc:
Shiny and golden.
As long as it's in your bag (no need to equip it), gold gained is increased by 20%.
equipment.armor_tycoon.name: Tycoon's Plate
equipment.armor_tycoon.desc:
Every scar is income.
Max HP +10.
The 1st/5th/10th time you take actual damage each battle, immediately gain 50 gold (dodged/blocked/fully-shielded/invincible hits don't count; resets every battle).
equipment.armor_tycoon.effect.2: The 1st/5th/10th time you take actual damage each battle, immediately gain 50 gold (dodged/blocked/fully-shielded/invincible hits don't count).
equipment.weapon_speculator_blade.name: Speculator's Blade
equipment.weapon_speculator_blade.desc:
Every swing of the blade is a trade.
All Slay-type cards (Slay/Fire/Thunder/Ice/Sure/Shadow Slay, etc.) deal +2 damage.
The 1st/5th/10th time you play a Slay-type card each battle, gain 30 gold (whether it hits or not; resets every battle).
equipment.weapon_speculator_blade.effect: All Slay-type cards (Slay/Fire/Thunder/Ice/Sure/Shadow Slay, etc.) deal +2 damage.
The 1st/5th/10th time you play a Slay-type card each battle, gain 30 gold.
equipment.weapon_reaper.name: Reaper
equipment.weapon_reaper.desc:
The endgame is the harvest.
When an enemy is at or below 10% HP, your next damage executes the target outright (works on Bosses; death triggers and rewards resolve normally).
Gain 25 gold on a successful execution.
equipment.weapon_reaper.effect.1: When an enemy is at or below 10% HP, your next damage executes the target outright (works on Bosses; death triggers and rewards resolve normally).
equipment.weapon_reaper.effect.2: Gain 25 gold on a successful execution.
equipment.vampiric_fang.name: Vampiric Fang
equipment.vampiric_fang.desc: The first time each round your active attack deals damage, restore HP equal to 25% of that damage (rounded down, at most once per round). Poison, buff damage-over-time, reflect damage, non-active true damage, and indirect damage never trigger this.
equipment.vampiric_fang.effect.1: The first time each round your active attack deals damage, restore HP equal to 25% of that damage (rounded down, at most once per round).
equipment.accessory_mi_jiang.name: Honey Elixir
equipment.accessory_mi_jiang.desc: A thick, sweet liquid brimming with vitality.
equipment.armor_gang_dun.name: Alloy Shield
equipment.armor_gang_dun.desc: Upgraded from the Rusty Shield. Gain 30 Max HP.
equipment.armor_giant_shield.name: Giant Shield
equipment.armor_giant_shield.desc:
A massive shield that turns its wielder's vitality into overwhelming force.

Gain 45 Max HP. Your active attacks deal bonus damage equal to 3% of your current HP (rounded down).
equipment.weapon_folding_knife.name: Folding Knife
equipment.weapon_folding_knife.desc:
When unfolded, its blade splits into two swift, lethal strikes.

Your normal Slay deals 5 damage twice. Each hit independently resolves normal-Slay bonuses, shields, and on-hit effects.
equipment.accessory_reforger.name: Reforger
equipment.accessory_reforger.desc:
Its inner gears still turn slowly.
After selling it, the next equipment you sell is replaced with a different item of the same rarity.
equipment.accessory_high_temperature_mod:
Its core temperature is locked above the danger line.
Your Fire-attribute attack damage ×1.5. Equipment, skill, and environmental fire damage are unaffected.
equipment.accessory_poison_dan.name: Poison Dan
equipment.accessory_poison_dan.desc:
It seems to have been brewed by a thoroughly wicked person.
All in-battle healing becomes HP loss; after each conversion, gain maximum HP equal to 10% of the converted value (at least 1).
equipment.mount_chi_tu.name: Red Hare
equipment.mount_chi_tu.desc: Provides powerful burst potential in the first round. Lü Bu gains further enhancement when equipped.
equipment.mount_mu_niu_liu_ma.name: Wooden Ox & Gliding Horse
equipment.mount_mu_niu_liu_ma.desc: Provides continuous Mana growth. Ideal for long-term builds.
equipment.treasure_donkey.name: Treasure Donkey
equipment.treasure_donkey.desc: At the end of each victorious battle, gain Power equal to the integer part of your remaining Mana, up to 20 per battle. Fractional Mana is ignored.
equipment.weapon_hejin_jian.name: Alloy Sword
equipment.weapon_hejin_jian.desc: Upgraded from the Rusty Sword. Slay hits all enemies and deals +5 damage.
equipment.weapon_hejin_mao.name: Alloy Spear
equipment.weapon_hejin_mao.desc: Upgraded from the Rusty Spear. All Slay damage +10.
equipment.broken_emotional_component.des: A broken heart, a broken person.
equipment.expansion_chip.name: Expansion Chip
equipment.expansion_chip.desc: Breaks through the original hardware limits, adding more ports to the body.
equipment.xian_hao.name: Immortal Hair
equipment.xian_hao.desc: A brushstroke bends fate. Uses no equipment slot; it may negate incoming attack damage, and each attack hit improves that chance.
equipment.skill_chip.name: Skill Chip
equipment.skill_chip.desc: Stores unclassified combat experience. Choose it to gain one random skill of any rarity.
equipment.skill_chip.flavor: On contact, it decompresses an unfamiliar combat memory, then quietly powers down.
equipment.armor_ice_blue.name: Ice-Blue Armor
equipment.armor_ice_blue.desc: Cold air circulates endlessly inside the armor, as if time itself is frozen. Gain 7 Mana at battle start; you can no longer use Fee to restore Mana.
equipment.barbarian_tooth.name: Barbarian Tooth
equipment.barbarian_tooth.desc: Gain 3 stacks of Ferocity at the start of battle. Ferocity: Slay damage ×1.5 when attacking; lose 1 stack at the end of each round.
equipment.weapon_zhang_ba_she_mao.name: Zhang Ba Snake Spear
equipment.weapon_zhang_ba_she_mao.desc: Zhang Fei exclusive. Slay damage +5; after two consecutive Slay rounds, gain 0.5 Mana.
equipment.weapon_qing_long_yan_yue_dao.d: Guan Yu exclusive. Slay damage +5; when the player evades your attack, refund 1 Mana.
equipment.zhuque_yushan.name: Vermillion Bird Fan
equipment.zhuque_yushan.desc: Fire Slay deals double damage. Zhou Yu's Fire Attack also deals double damage.
equipment.true_blue_steel_sword.name: True Blue Steel Sword
equipment.true_blue_steel_sword.desc: All Slay damage +15. Applies to Slay, Fire Slay, Thunder Slay, and True Slay. Reforged in the Ancient Shu Furnace — the blue steel gleams anew.
equipment.zhuge_crossbow.name: Zhuge Repeating Crossbow
equipment.zhuge_crossbow.desc: Crafted with the finest technology. Slay costs 0 Mana. The first Slay each round enters Rapid-Fire Mode (2 seconds): unlimited Slays, each resolving normally; after 2 seconds the round ends.
equipment.weapon_plague_staff.name: Plague Staff
equipment.weapon_plague_staff.desc: A staff that drips dark-green venom. Slay evolves into Poison Slay: on hit, deal 10 Poison damage and apply 10 Plague stacks. (Plague: at 10 stacks, deal 10 true Poison damage; recovering HP removes 5 stacks.)
equipment.armor_conductor.name: Conductor
equipment.armor_conductor.desc: Special conductive armor that channels most lightning into the ground. Gain 10 max HP. Thunder-type damage received is reduced by 75% (still counts as receiving a Thunder-type attack; does not prevent skills like Yellow Sky from triggering).
equipment.accessory_electric_shackle.des: At the start of each round, deal 1 Thunder self-damage (equipment self-damage; does not trigger attack-based feedback such as Blood Debt). Afterward, all external damage taken this round is reduced by 10%.
equipment.accessory_discount_voucher.des: Big shop sale! While held, all shop items cost 25% less.
equipment.accessory_time_hourglass.name: Time Hourglass
equipment.accessory_time_hourglass.desc: Its sand flows backward, projecting the battlefield's end into the present. At battle start, trigger the round 55 HP-loss effect once.
equipment.accessory_time_hourglass.effec: At battle start, trigger the Battlefield Collapse round-55 effect once.
equipment.accessory_night_vision_goggles:
Locks onto the most conspicuous target in view; everything else is just noise.
Single-target damage attack cards deal ×1.2 damage; group damage attack cards instead focus-fire one enemy on the field, dealing damage ×the number of enemies alive.
Single-target damage attack cards (Sha family) deal ×1.2 damage.
Group damage attack cards (Arrow Barrage / Nanman Invasion / Raid / Celestial Impact) instead focus-fire one enemy on the field, dealing damage ×the number of enemies alive.
equipment.armor_stealth_module.name: Stealth Module
equipment.armor_stealth_module.desc:
It bends light around the wearer, quietly erasing them from the battlefield—until they pull the trigger themselves.
Gain invincibility at battle start; lose it immediately when round 10 begins, or when you play a resource/Sha-family/trick card.
equipment.armor_stealth_module.effect.2: Lose invincibility immediately when round 10 begins, or when you play a resource/Sha-family/trick card.
event.changbanpo.name: Changban Slope
event.changbanpo.desc:
Changban Slope has become a vast field of graves.
Bones blanket the ground, amid scattered worthless debris.
event.xiandan_shushi.name: The Alchemist
event.xiandan_shushi.desc:
A gaunt old man clutches an enormous gourd.
He watches you, as though he has been awaiting your choice for a very long time.
event.tavern.name: The Tavern
event.tavern.desc: A lively little tavern in the heart of the bustling market district. A place where all manner of folk mingle.
event.shop_general.name: The Shop
event.ancient_phantom.name: The Phantom of Old
event.ancient_phantom.desc:
A blurred silhouette materializes before you.
It has no face, no voice — yet you sense a will reaching toward you from across some vast distance.

It seems to be beckoning you somewhere.
event.giant_stone_stele.name: The Colossal Stele
event.giant_stone_stele.desc:
Iron and bones are embedded within it.
A symbol of prosperity.
event.modification_shop.name: The Modification Workshop
event.modification_shop.desc:
Every corner is crammed with limbs and components.
There is barely room to set foot inside.
event.treasure_pavilion.name: The Treasure Vault
event.treasure_pavilion.desc:
A treasure vault hidden deep within the ruins.
Its heavy iron doors have been forced open.
Vast stores of precious equipment seem to wait within.
But the great guardian of the hoard still stirs.
event.ancient_forge.name: The Ancient Shu Furnace
event.ancient_forge.desc:
You arrive at an ancient forge that still burns.
An azure flame within has not been extinguished in a thousand years.
Engraved on the furnace wall: "Blades may be reforged. Souls may not return."
event.forbidden_library.name: The Forbidden Archive
event.forbidden_library.desc: A vault housing all manner of memory chips.
event.qixingtan.name: The Seven-Star Altar
event.qixingtan.desc:
A crumbling altar still stands deep within the palace walls.
Seven stone pillars encircle the ritual formation at its heart.
event.han_shi_zong_ci.name: The Han Ancestral Temple
event.han_shi_zong_ci.desc:
Countless memorial tablets stand in neat rows.

The air carries the faint scent of incense.

Four great characters are carved into the wall:

"Restore the Han."
event.imprisoned_elf.name: The Imprisoned Sprite
event.imprisoned_elf.desc:
Deep within a dim prison cell.

A sprite lies bound in heavy chains.

It turns toward you with hollow, exhausted eyes.

A look of fear — and desperate hope — fills its gaze.
event.event_stinky_mushroom.name: Stinky Mushroom
event.event_stinky_mushroom.desc:
You discover a huge patch of green mushrooms.
Sticky mycelium wraps around the entire sewer, constantly giving off a nauseating stench.
Deep within the caps, faint glimmers of red, yellow, and green flicker.
event.explosive_fruit.name: Explosive Fruit
event.explosive_fruit.desc: A huge red fruit rests by the roadside. It looks as though the slightest touch could unleash enormous energy.
event.event_abyss_placeholder.name: Echoes of the Abyss
event.event_abyss_placeholder.desc: An unintelligible whisper comes from deep in the darkness.
event.event_abyss_placeholder.option1.de: Ignore the whispers and press on.
event.event_abyss_placeholder.option1.re: You ignore the whispers and continue onward.
event.event_tutorial_roadside_supply.des: You find a supply cache no one has picked over yet.
event.event_tutorial_roadside_supply.opt: You took the gold from the cache.
Use the supplies to bandage up
You bandaged your wounds and recovered a bit of health.
event.rat_king_event.name: The Rat King
event.rat_king_event.desc:
In the depths of the sewer.
A swarm of rats circles a rotting banquet table.
One among them — enormous, regal — sits at the head.
It clutches an ancient scepter in its paws.

Spotting your arrival, it smiles and beckons you closer.

"Join us for dinner."
event.short_circuit_memory.name: Unexpected Short Circuit
event.short_circuit_memory.desc: You short-circuit without warning — but the surge calls up fragments of battle experience buried long ago.
event.talking_sword.name: The Talking Sword
event.talking_sword.desc:
You find a black longsword driven into a stone by the road.

As you draw near, it suddenly speaks:

"Someone has finally come."

"Pull me free — I have been trapped here far too long."

"Wait... you're not thinking of selling me, are you?"
event.blood_pool.name: The Blood Pool
event.blood_pool.desc:
The pond in the distance has been stained crimson.
Bubbles surge ceaselessly up from the depths.
The air reeks of iron and rust.
You sense, dimly, that something at the bottom of the pool is watching you.
event.chibi_ruins.name: Ruins of the Red Cliffs
event.chibi_ruins.desc: Red Cliffs has become a fetid swamp. In the distance, colossal shipwrecks left by the ancient war are still visible.
event.greedy_vault.name: Vault of Greed
event.greedy_vault.desc:
You've discovered an ancient vault sealed shut by massive boulders.

The air reeks of blood. Gold bars and coins are piled high, and at the center stands a golden statue radiating an eerie light, as if waiting for a new sacrifice.
event.vehicle_shop_event.name: The Vehicle Shop
event.vehicle_shop_event.desc:
A peculiar shop tucked away in a corner of the city.
No weapons for sale here.
No armor either.
The proprietor seems to care only for strange and exotic conveyances.
event.manzu_camp.name: The Nanman War Camp
event.manzu_camp.desc:
Deep in the mountain forest you discover a camp of southern tribal warriors.
Bonfires still burn; the scent of roasting meat hangs in the air.
The tribesmen size you up with wary eyes.
event.ruler_statue.name: The Ruler's Statue
event.ruler_statue.desc:
The ruler of this city is [{chapter2_boss_name}].
The statue records the contributions this ruler made to the city —
or perhaps the exploitation and oppression he left behind.
Time has long since worn the inscriptions into obscurity.
But something inside the statue still seems to be running.
event.chasing_pursuers.name: Pursuers
event.chasing_pursuers.desc:
Because you destroyed the city statue, a search squad has finally tracked you down.
They demand you hand over the relic you stole, or they will attack immediately.
event.life_spring.name: The Spring of Life
event.life_spring.desc:
A clear spring wells up from beneath the earth.
They say it holds the power to alter fate itself.
Some who drank from it were reborn.
Others were cast into ruin.
event.witch.name: The Witch
event.witch.desc:
Deep in the lightless sewers, a crone draped in black robes tends a great cauldron at full boil.
She raises her head slowly, revealing a grotesque smile.

"Young one — have you come seeking the future... or seeking fortune?"

event.changbanpo.option1.name: Scavenge for Weapons
event.changbanpo.option1.desc: Search the graveyard for usable remains. Gain one Common weapon and one Common armor.
event.changbanpo.option2.name: Pick the Bodies
event.changbanpo.option2.desc: Strip the battlefield dead of their valuables. Gain 100 Gold.
event.changbanpo.option2.result: You collected 100 Gold from the remains and relics.
event.changbanpo.option3.name: Absorb Memories
event.changbanpo.option3.desc: Distill information from the lingering battlefield will. Gain one Defense Chip.
event.changbanpo.option4.name: Search the Ancient Well
event.changbanpo.option4.desc: Explore a forgotten well deep in the ruins — something unusual may lie within.
event.changbanpo.option4.result:
In a long-forgotten well, you found Zhao Yun's lost weapon.
You also discovered a mysterious chip of unknown origin.
event.changbanpo.option5.name: Mourn
event.changbanpo.option5.desc: Mourn the Shu soldiers who died here. Gain one Knowledge Chip.
event.changbanpo.option6.name: Mourn
event.changbanpo.option6.desc: Mourn the Wei soldiers who died here. Gain one Attack Chip.
event.changbanpo.option6.result: The leftover weapon chips still function — Attack Chip +1.
event.xiandan_shushi.option1.name: Seek Medicine
event.xiandan_shushi.option1.desc: Spend 100 Gold — permanently gain 10 Max HP. (Requires 100+ Gold)
event.xiandan_shushi.option2.name: Ask for Directions
event.xiandan_shushi.option2.desc: Win your next battle to receive a random piece of equipment.
event.xiandan_shushi.option2.result: You will receive a random piece of equipment after your next victory.
event.xiandan_shushi.option3.name: Seek Enlightenment
event.xiandan_shushi.option3.desc: Defeat the Chapter 1 Boss to receive the [Elixir Pill] equipment.
event.xiandan_shushi.option4.name: Seek the Way
event.xiandan_shushi.option4.desc: Spend 150 Gold to receive the [Mysterious Chip] equipment. (Requires 150+ Gold)
event.xiandan_shushi.option4.result:
The old man places the gourd in your hands.

You received [Mysterious Chip].
event.tavern.option1.name: Rest
event.tavern.option2.name: Order a Drink
event.tavern.option2.desc: Requires 75+ Gold. Spend 75 Gold — for the rest of this run, using Wine to rescue yourself from near-death costs no fee (normally costs 1 fee).
event.tavern.option2.result:
You drink deep, and warmth spreads through you.

For the rest of this run, Wine-based near-death rescues are free.
event.tavern.option3.name: Black Market Deal
event.tavern.option3.desc: Enter the black market: equipment quality gains an extra 10% chance to roll Legendary, but all prices are increased by 50%.
event.witch.option1.name: Touch the Crystal Ball
event.witch.option1.desc: Spend 200 Gold — immediately trigger a random non-shop event from Chapter 3.
event.witch.option2.name: Browse Her Wares
event.witch.option3.name: Knock Her Out
event.witch.option3.result:
You gave her no time to speak.
You knocked the witch out cold and tore off her scalp.
Obtained: [Witch's Scalp]
event.giant_stone_stele.option1.name: Offer Gold, Gain Power
event.giant_stone_stele.option1.desc: Spend 100 Gold — all offensive Trick cards permanently deal +10 damage. (Requires 100+ Gold)
event.giant_stone_stele.option1.result:
The stele exhaled a thread of spirit energy.
It surged through your body like electricity.
Your offensive trick cards have become far more deadly.
event.giant_stone_stele.option2.name: Offer Gold, Gain Vitality
event.giant_stone_stele.option2.result:
The stele exhaled a thread of spirit energy.
It surged through your body like electricity.
Your life force has been strengthened.
event.giant_stone_stele.option3.name: Offer Blood
event.giant_stone_stele.option3.desc: Lose 50 maximum HP and obtain a Skill Chip. (Requires at least 51 maximum HP)
event.giant_stone_stele.option4.name: Sharpen on the Stele
event.giant_stone_stele.option4.desc: Hone rusty equipment on the stele. All owned Rusty Shield / Sword / Spear / Blue-Steel Sword / Guding Blade become their upgraded versions.
event.giant_stone_stele.option4.result: The stele consumes every rusty item. As the rust falls away, upgraded equipment returns to your hands.
event.modification_shop.option1.name: Accept Modification
event.modification_shop.option1.desc: Spend 75 Gold and choose one of three chips.
event.modification_shop.option2.name: Broke — Pocket Some Parts
event.modification_shop.option2.result_f: You pocketed some spare parts and sold them for {0} Gold.
event.modification_shop.option3.name: Modify Weapon
event.modification_shop.option3.desc: Spend 75 Gold. Three random owned weapons, including equipped weapons, are shown; choose one to reforge.
event.modification_shop.reforge.title: Modify Weapon
event.modification_shop.reforge.desc: Choose one of three randomly selected weapons to reforge.
event.treasure_pavilion.option1.name: Enter
event.treasure_pavilion.option1.desc: Enter a special battle. Upon victory, choose 1 of 3 random Epic-tier equipment.
event.treasure_pavilion.option2.name: Leave
event.treasure_pavilion.option2.desc: Gain 50 Gold and walk away from the Treasure Pavilion.
event.treasure_pavilion.option2.result:
You slipped away without disturbing the creature deep inside.
You took the 50 Gold scattered by the entrance.
event.treasure_pavilion.option3.name: Soul Sacrifice
event.treasure_pavilion.option3.desc: Visible when you own a Soul Stone. Without consuming it, directly choose 1 of 3 Epic equipment and gain 200 Gold.
event.shop_general.option1.name: Enter Shop
event.shop_general.option1.desc: Gain 75 Gold, then enter the shop.
event.shop_general.option1.result: You gain 75 Gold and enter the shop.
event.shop_general.option2.name: Rob the Place
event.shop_general.option2.desc: Lose 10 Power and gain 225 Gold. (Requires at least 10 Power)
event.shop_general.option2.result:
You storm the shop and sweep the register.
Lose 10 Power and gain 225 Gold.
event.ancient_phantom.option1.name: Follow the Guidance
event.ancient_phantom.option1.desc:
Let the phantom lead you into the unknown depths.
Max HP +10, Current HP +10, next chapter takes the Sewer route, and gain [Darkness].
event.ancient_phantom.option1.result:
The phantom dissolved.
You feel your body brimming with strength, and an unfamiliar road forms in your mind.
Darkness coils around you — enemies in your next battle will be more powerful.
event.ancient_phantom.option2.name: Stand Firm
event.ancient_phantom.option2.desc:
Remain unmoved and watch what unfolds.
Obtain [Soul Stone].
event.ancient_phantom.option2.result:
The phantom solidified into a stone and fell into your palm.
It glows faintly, as if waiting for the right moment.
event.ancient_phantom.option3.name: Exploit It (HP ≤ 30)
event.ancient_phantom.option3.desc:
While weakened, actively resonate with the phantom and absorb its power.
Max HP +10, Current HP +10, obtain [Soul Stone].
event.ancient_phantom.option3.result:
Pain and power intertwined.
The phantom merged with you, leaving behind a warm stone.
event.ruler_statue.option1.name: Destroy the Statue
event.ruler_statue.option1.desc: You swing your weapon and smash the statue. Swarms of insects pour from the base. When the chaos settles, you find a strange stone among the rubble.
event.ruler_statue.option1.result:
The statue crumbled completely.
You found a strange stone amid the wreckage.
Obtained [Forgotten Stone].
event.ruler_statue.option2.name: Steal the Statue's Core
event.ruler_statue.option2.desc: You pry open the statue's shell and extract its ever-spinning core. It seems to whisper constantly. It tells you — it does not belong here.
event.ruler_statue.option2.result:
You extracted the endlessly spinning core from inside the statue.
It still vibrates faintly in your hand.
Obtained [Statue Core].
event.chasing_pursuers.option1.name: Fight Your Way Out
event.chasing_pursuers.option1.desc: Face the 3 Pursuers head-on. Winning keeps your [Forgotten Stone]/[Statue Core] (if you have them) and grants 100 gold.
event.chasing_pursuers.option2.name: Hand Over the Loot
event.chasing_pursuers.option2.desc: Hand over your [Forgotten Stone]/[Statue Core] (if you have them) in exchange for safe passage, and restore 15 HP.
event.chasing_pursuers.option2.result:
You handed over the stolen relic.
The search squad left satisfied.
Restored 15 HP.
event.chasing_pursuers.option3.name: Feint and Flee
event.chasing_pursuers.option3.desc:
Create a diversion and slip away.
50% success: keep all relics, gain 50 gold.
50% failure: lose your [Forgotten Stone]/[Statue Core] (if you have them) and 15 HP.
event.life_spring.option1.name: Drink from the Spring
event.life_spring.option1.desc: Gain 20% of your Max HP cap; Current HP increases by the same amount.
event.life_spring.option1.result: You drank the spring water. The icy power surged through your entire body.
event.life_spring.option2.name: Temper Your Blade
event.life_spring.option2.desc: If you own qualifying equipment, permanently gain +5 Slay-family damage. A Rusty Guding Blade is also upgraded into a Guding Blade.
event.life_spring.option2.result: The spring water left new patterns along the blade's edge.
event.life_spring.option3.name: Take the Spring's Source
event.life_spring.option3.desc: Gain Curse ×2 and immediately gain 1 Forage.
event.life_spring.option3.result: You took residual energy from the deepest part of the spring. A chill immediately wrapped itself around you.
event.short_circuit_memory.option1.name: Lose Thunder Slay, gain [Nanman Invasion]
event.short_circuit_memory.option1.desc: Remove [Thunder Slay] and replace it with [Nanman Invasion]. (Requires Thunder Slay in deck)
event.short_circuit_memory.option1.resul:
The current rewired itself through your nerves.
The thunder-strike memory faded; the invasion command was written into your core.
event.short_circuit_memory.option2.name: Lose Fire Slay, gain [Arrow Barrage]
event.short_circuit_memory.option2.desc: Remove [Fire Slay] and replace it with [Arrow Barrage]. (Requires Fire Slay in deck)
event.short_circuit_memory.option2.resul:
The scorching current burned through the outline of an old battlefield.
The flame memory faded; the barrage command was written into your core.
event.short_circuit_memory.option3.name: Lose Fire Slay and pay 200 Gold for [Fire Attack]
event.short_circuit_memory.option3.desc: Remove [Fire Slay], pay 200 Gold, and replace it with [Fire Attack]. (Requires Fire Slay and at least 200 Gold)
event.short_circuit_memory.option3.resul:
The searing battle memory is compiled anew.
The old Fire Slay command goes dark; the Fire Attack protocol is written into your core.
event.short_circuit_memory.option4.name: Lose 50 Gold, gain [Steal]
event.short_circuit_memory.option4.resul:
You trade an expensive fragment of old code for a plunder protocol.
[Steal] has been added to your action bar.
event.short_circuit_memory.option5.name: Gain a chip choice (pick 1 of 3)
event.short_circuit_memory.option5.desc: Choose one of Attack Chip, Defense Chip, or Knowledge Chip.
event.talking_sword.option1.name: Pull It Out
event.talking_sword.option1.desc: Gain 3 Curse stacks and obtain [Cursed Blade].
event.talking_sword.option1.result:
You drew the sword.
It let out a quiet laugh.
You suffered 3 Curse stacks and obtained [Cursed Blade].
event.talking_sword.option2.name: Ignore It
event.talking_sword.option2.result:
You expertly pried the ruby off the hilt.
Furious cursing echoed behind you.
Gained 150 Gold.
event.talking_sword.option3.name: Intimidate It
event.talking_sword.option3.desc: Lose 10 Current HP — gain a choose-one-of-three Chip opportunity.
event.blood_pool.option1.name: Bloodletting
event.blood_pool.option1.desc: Lose 10 Current HP, gain 5 Max HP, then remain at the blood pool.
event.blood_pool.option2.name: Drink from the Pool
event.blood_pool.option2.result:
You knelt and drank from the crimson pool.
The warm liquid flowed into your body as if alive.
You have drawn the [Moon's] attention.
event.blood_pool.option3.name: Fish Out Bones
event.blood_pool.option3.result:
You dragged a massive bone out of the blood pool.
Obtained [Big Bone Club].
event.chibi_ruins.option1.name: Salvage the Wreck
event.chibi_ruins.option1.desc: Climb aboard the listing warships. Obtain two random Common equipment.
event.chibi_ruins.option2.name: Find a Boatman
event.chibi_ruins.option2.desc: Restore 10 HP and obtain [Waterproof Module]. Free for Wu faction; 50 Gold for all other factions.
event.chibi_ruins.option2.result:
You found a boatman hiding in the reeds.
He guided you around the deepest mud and handed you a sealed module.

HP +10, obtained [Waterproof Module].
event.chibi_ruins.option3.name: Enter the Swamp
event.chibi_ruins.option3.desc: Follow the call from deep within the swamp and enter the [Ancient Phantom] event.
event.chibi_ruins.option4.name: Enter Huarong Path
event.chibi_ruins.option4.desc: Continue along the ancient Huarong road — gain one choose-one-of-three Chip opportunity. (Requires faction: Wei)
event.greedy_vault.option1.name: Choose Gold
event.greedy_vault.option2.name: Search for Treasure

event.manzu_camp.option2.name: Challenge to a Duel
event.manzu_camp.option2.desc: Challenge the tribe's warrior to single combat (Exile Manzoku ×2). Win to obtain [Manzoku Fang].
event.manzu_camp.option3.name: Feast Heartily
event.manzu_camp.option3.desc: Spend 100 Gold to share the camp's feast — restore to full HP, Max HP +10, Current HP +10.

event.manzu_camp.option5.name: Recruit Reinforcements

Nanman Invasion damage ×2; each hit restores 5 HP and 0.5 Cost. (Meng Huo exclusive)
event.ancient_forge.option1.name: Sacrifice Equipment
event.ancient_forge.option1.desc: Throw all your equipment and gold into the ancient furnace in exchange for a legendary weapon. Gain 2 Curse stacks.
event.ancient_forge.option2.name: Sacrifice Soul
event.ancient_forge.option2.desc: Channel your life essence into the furnace — set Current HP to 1 and reduce Max HP by 30%, in exchange for a legendary item.
event.ancient_forge.option3.name: Search for Equipment

event.ancient_forge.option4.name: Reforge

event.ancient_forge.option5.name: Offer the Blue-Steel Sword
event.ancient_forge.option5.desc: Only shown when Zhao Yun owns the Blue-Steel Sword and Mysterious Chip. Consume both to obtain the True Blue-Steel Sword.
event.ancient_forge.option5.result:
The Blue-Steel Sword ascended in the flames.
The True Blue-Steel Sword trembles faintly in your hand, radiating piercing cold brilliance.
Obtained [True Blue-Steel Sword].
event.ancient_forge.option6.name: Offer the Guding Blade
event.ancient_forge.option6.desc: Only shown when Xu Sheng owns the Guding Blade and Mysterious Chip. Consume both to obtain the True Guding Blade.
event.ancient_forge.option6.result:
Fire and thunder burst from the Guding Blade in the azure flame.
The Mysterious Chip becomes its new core.
Obtained [True Guding Blade].
event.forbidden_library.option1.name: Recycle Memories

event.forbidden_library.option2.name: Buy Access Rights

event.forbidden_library.option3.name: Read the Forbidden Books
event.forbidden_library.option3.desc: Delve into the restricted archives — perform two consecutive choose-one-of-three Chip selections.
event.forbidden_library.option4.name: Access the Supreme Database
event.forbidden_library.option4.desc: Lu Meng stares at the central terminal. A buried permission code begins to resonate — the seal on the Restrained Protocol is breaking.
event.forbidden_library.option4.result:
Permission verified.
Restrained Protocol upgrade complete.
Resource limits lifted — Cost cap 20, each 1 Cost grants +10% damage, immune to Nimble Fingers.
event.qixingtan.option1.name: Perform Divination
event.qixingtan.option1.desc: Step into the ritual array and feel the killing aura. Gain [Killing Aura]: HP permanently locked at 1, healing is fully disabled, but all damage you deal ×1.5. (Permanent, until run ends)
event.qixingtan.option1.result:
The killing aura surged into you like a tide. You feel utterly frail, yet bursting with power.
[Killing Aura] has possessed you — HP forever 1, but every strike you land carries annihilating force.
event.qixingtan.option2.name: Perform a Ritual Summoning
event.qixingtan.option2.desc:
Light the Seven-Star Lanterns to challenge an empowered soul of the Chapter 1 Boss. Enemy HP ×3, damage dealt ×2.
Victory: gain [Soul Stone] ×2. Defeat: resolved as a normal battle loss.
event.qixingtan.option3.name: Loot the Area
event.qixingtan.option3.desc: Search the stone pillars around the altar for relics — you discover an ornate fan. Obtain [Vermilion Bird Fan].
event.qixingtan.option3.result:
The fan grew gently warm — the Vermilion Bird's spirit is sealed within.
Obtained [Vermilion Bird Fan]: Fire Slay deals double damage.
event.qixingtan.option4.name: Restart the Seven-Star Array
event.qixingtan.option4.desc: Zhuge Liang stares at the seven pillars; a fragment of an array suddenly surfaces in his mind. Using [Stargazing] as the catalyst, restart the Seven-Star Array — upgrade [Stargazing] to [Heaven's Mechanism].
event.qixingtan.option4.result:
The Seven-Star Array roared to life, pillars of light shooting skyward. The art of Stargazing ascended through the array's resonance.
[Heaven's Mechanism] has awakened — using Stargazing now instantly grants 1 Cost (the Cost is still paid normally).
event.imprisoned_elf.option1.name: Free It
event.imprisoned_elf.option1.desc: The elf thanks you for your help. Choose one element to gain a permanent enhancement.
event.imprisoned_elf.option2.name: Torture It

event.imprisoned_elf.option3.name: Coerce It

event.imprisoned_elf.option4.name: Take It to Sell

You handed the elf over to the highest bidder.

Gained 500 Gold.
event.imprisoned_elf.option5.name: Recover It
event.imprisoned_elf.option5.desc: Obtain [Elf Dust]. Peach base healing permanently +5 this run.
event.imprisoned_elf.option5.result:
The elf's breathing gradually steadied.
It placed a glimmer of shimmering dust in your hand.

Gained equipment: [Elf Dust].
Peach base healing permanently +5.
event.han_shi_zong_ci.option1.name: Offer Incense
event.han_shi_zong_ci.option1.desc: Light candles and bow to the ancestors. Obtain one random Epic-tier accessory.
event.han_shi_zong_ci.option2.name: Topple the Tablets
event.han_shi_zong_ci.option2.desc: Sweep the ancestor tablets to the ground and loot the offerings. Gain 300 Gold and 3 Curse stacks.
event.han_shi_zong_ci.option3.name: Steal the Offerings
event.han_shi_zong_ci.option3.desc: Immediately gain 15 Max HP. The wine damage multiplier is permanently increased by 0.5× this run.
event.han_shi_zong_ci.option4.name: Soul Takeover
event.han_shi_zong_ci.option4.desc: Remove all skills not protected by a Soul mark; destroy all equipment; randomly gain one Legendary, one Epic, one Rare, and one Common skill.
event.han_shi_zong_ci.option5.name: Insert the Mysterious Chip
event.han_shi_zong_ci.option5.desc: Lose the Mysterious Chip — awaken the ancestral resonance deep within the shrine and gain [Ancestral Blessing].
event.han_shi_zong_ci.option5.result:
The mysterious chip slots into a crack at the shrine's center.
Fine patterns light up the wall behind the tablets; the incense smoke condenses into a golden silhouette.

You hear countless voices whispering in unison:
"The Han Dynasty is not yet finished."

Gained [Ancestral Blessing ×3].

codex.battlebuff.peach_shield.name: Peach Shield
codex.battlebuff.peach_shield.desc: Blocks one instance of damage; if triggered, the corresponding Peach no longer restores HP.
codex.battlebuff.peach_shield.detail: The Peach Shield gained this turn blocks one attack of any type. If the shield triggers, the paired Peach's healing is immediately cancelled.
codex.battlebuff.wine_shield.name: Wine Shield
codex.battlebuff.wine_shield.desc: Blocks one instance of damage; if triggered, the corresponding Wine bonus damage is lost.
codex.battlebuff.wine_shield.detail: Wine provides a one-time shield this turn and stores bonus damage for the next turn. If the shield triggers first, the corresponding Wine stacks are cleared immediately and do not carry over.
codex.battlebuff.dodge_defense.name: Dodge State
codex.battlebuff.dodge_defense.desc: Fully defends against Slay, Fire Slay, and Arrow Barrage this turn.
codex.battlebuff.dodge_defense.detail: Playing Dodge grants a defensive state lasting until the end of this turn. It fully defends against Slay, Fire Slay, and Arrow Barrage, but cannot defend against Thunder Slay, True Slay, or Steal.
codex.battlebuff.counter_defense.name: Counter Defense
codex.battlebuff.counter_defense.desc: Fully defends against Steal, Thunder Slay, Arrow Barrage, and True Slay this turn.
codex.battlebuff.counter_defense.detail: Playing Unassailable grants a counter-defense state lasting until the end of this turn. It covers all corresponding card types and is not consumed by uses.
codex.battlebuff.frozen.name: Frozen
codex.battlebuff.frozen.desc: Next turn you can only play Fee.
codex.battlebuff.frozen.detail: Entering frozen state from Ice Slay or similar effects forces the action slot to Fee. Both AI and player may only select from the current action slot.
codex.battlebuff.darkness.name: Darkness
codex.battlebuff.darkness.desc: All enemies gain +30% max HP in the next battle.
codex.battlebuff.darkness.detail: Darkness is a Run Buff applied to enemy max HP when entering battle. It automatically decrements its duration counter after the battle ends.
