initial_event.ie_01.desc:
When entering Chapter 2, choose 1 skill from 3 options (Common/Rare).
Penalty: HP does not automatically recover after each battle.
initial_event.ie_01.detail:
Penalty: HP does not automatically recover after each battle (rice soup excluded).
Effect: When entering Chapter 2, pick 1 from 3 randomly drawn Common/Rare skills.
initial_event.ie_02.desc: The first 5 equipment pieces obtained this run are automatically destroyed. After the 5th is destroyed, choose 1 of 2 Legendary equipment.
initial_event.ie_02.detail:
Effect: Any equipment obtained is automatically destroyed (tracked by count).
After 5 total are destroyed, immediately trigger a pick-1-of-2 Legendary equipment reward.
initial_event.ie_03.desc:
After defeating the Chapter 1 Boss, randomly gain one of that Boss's skills (if you already own all of that Boss's skills, randomly gain a Rare skill instead).
Penalty: all Legendary enemies have +30% max HP.
initial_event.ie_03.detail:
Penalty: all Legendary enemies permanently gain +30% max HP.
Effect: Upon defeating the Chapter 1 Boss, randomly obtain one skill that Boss actually possesses; if you already own all of that Boss's skills, randomly obtain a Rare skill instead.
initial_event.ie_04.desc: Chip choices have a 5% chance to include a Mysterious Chip; Expansion and Skill Chips each rise to 10%.
initial_event.ie_04.detail: Effect: in every chip choice this run, a Mysterious Chip has a 5% chance to replace a normal chip; Expansion and Skill Chips each have a 10% replacement chance.
initial_event.ie_05.desc: Permanently gain 15 max HP and receive 100 gold.
initial_event.ie_05.detail: Effect: immediately and permanently gain 15 max HP (current HP also increases), and gain 100 gold.
initial_event.ie_06.desc: Immediately gain 50 gold and choose 1 of 3 random Rare equipment.
initial_event.ie_06.detail: Effect: immediately gain 50 gold. Enter a pick-1-of-3 Rare equipment screen and add your choice to your inventory.
initial_event.ie_07.desc: All shops become Black Markets, with no Black Market price premium.
initial_event.ie_07.detail: Effect: all shops use the Black Market item pool, including Legendary equipment, but charge normal shop prices.
initial_event.ie_08.desc: Each shop visit gains one additional refresh, and all refreshes are free.
initial_event.ie_08.detail: Effect: each shop visit allows two refreshes, both at no gold cost.
initial_event.ie_09.desc:
After winning each battle, permanently gain 5 max HP.
Penalty: Immediately lose 10 max HP.
initial_event.ie_09.detail:
Penalty: Immediately lose 10 max HP.
Effect: After winning each battle, permanently +5 max HP (stacks indefinitely).
initial_event.ie_10.desc: Remove all Fire Slays and Thunder Slays from your deck and replace them with Storm Slays. Future Fire/Thunder Slays you obtain are unaffected.
initial_event.ie_10.detail:
Effect: All Fire Slay and Thunder Slay cards in your starting deck are replaced with Storm Slay.
Fire/Thunder Slays obtained afterward through any means are not affected.
initial_event.ie_11.desc:
After defeating the Chapter 1 Boss, the reward is replaced with an Expansion Chip (permanently unlocks the universal equipment slot).
Penalty: Lose all starting gold.
initial_event.ie_11.detail:
Penalty: Immediately lose all starting gold.
Effect: Upon defeating the Chapter 1 Boss, the reward is replaced with an Expansion Chip (unlocks the 4th equipment slot).
initial_event.ie_12.detail: Effect: Permanently increases Max Power by 25 for this run (100 -> 125). Power is refilled to this new cap at the start of every chapter.
initial_event.ie_13.desc: Gain the global [Darkness] buff and 4 Knowledge Chips.
initial_event.ie_13.detail: Effect: immediately gain the global [Darkness] buff and 4 Knowledge Chips (each grants +5 base damage to offensive stratagems).
initial_event.ie_14.desc: Take zero cumulative damage across your first 3 battles to earn a pick-1-of-3 Epic equipment reward. Taking any damage immediately voids this.
initial_event.ie_14.detail:
Effect: Tracks whether damage is taken across the first 3 battles.
0 damage total → reward: pick 1 of 3 Epic equipment.
Any damage taken in any battle → immediately voided; no reward.
initial_event.ie_15.desc: Immediately obtain the Epic accessory [Paralysis Device].
initial_event.ie_15.detail: Effect: Immediately add the Epic accessory [Paralysis Device] to your inventory.
initial_event.ie_16.desc: The first battle is replaced with a random Elite encounter. The first event in Chapter 1 is replaced with a random Chapter 2 event.
initial_event.ie_16.detail:
Effect ①: The enemy composition of the first battle is replaced with an Elite encounter (random Chapter 1 elite content).
Effect ②: The first normal event in Chapter 1 is replaced with a random Chapter 2 event (city/sewer allowed; shop/Boss-exclusive/limited events excluded).
initial_event.ie_17.desc: Immediately gain 75 gold. After each battle, automatically restore HP to full.
initial_event.ie_17.detail: Effect: immediately gain 75 gold. After every battle ends, HP is fully restored to maximum.
initial_event.ie_18.desc: After formally entering 1-1, the first upgradeable equipment is replaced by random equipment of the same primary slot type at one rarity higher.
initial_event.ie_18.detail:
Effect: After formally entering 1-1, the first equipment whose rarity can be raised is replaced by random equipment of the same primary slot type at one rarity higher.
Common→Rare, Rare→Epic, Epic→Legendary. Legendary equipment or an empty candidate pool does not consume the effect.

tutorial.step.intro_player.title: Player Panel
tutorial.step.intro_player.desc:
This is your player panel.

[b]HP[/b]: Your current and maximum health. Reaching zero means defeat.

[b]Mana[/b]: Must be actively collected each turn. Used to play cost cards.

[b]Status[/b]: Shows active Buffs and DeBuffs affecting your stats.

[b]Skills[/b]: Character abilities that trigger automatically under certain conditions.

[b]Equipment[/b]: Boosts stats or grants special effects.
tutorial.step.intro_player.obj: Learn the player panel in the lower left
tutorial.step.intro_player.tips: HP and Mana are the two core resources — watch both at all times.
tutorial.step.intro_enemy.title: Enemy Panel
tutorial.step.intro_enemy.desc:
This is the enemy panel.

[b]HP[/b]: Reduce the enemy's HP to zero to win the battle.

[b]Mana[/b]: Enemies also need to build mana before playing cards.

[b]Skills & Equipment[/b]: Hover over the enemy avatar to view their details.

[b]Buffs[/b]: Status effects the enemy currently has — may affect attack or defense.
tutorial.step.intro_enemy.obj: Learn the enemy panel at the top
tutorial.step.intro_enemy.tips: Check enemy skills before the battle begins — plan your strategy accordingly.
tutorial.step.intro_fee.title: [Fee]
tutorial.step.intro_fee.desc:
The most important resource in battle.

[b]What[/b]: Play a [Fee] card to gain 1 point of mana.

[b]Effect[/b]: Mana is required for Kill, Fire Kill, Peach, and other cost cards.

[b]When to use[/b]: Play Fee first each turn to ensure you have enough mana.

[b]Type[/b]: Resource card — no type restrictions.
tutorial.step.intro_fee.obj: Click the [Fee] card in your hand
tutorial.step.intro_fee.tips: Mana does not regenerate — you must actively play Fee cards to build it up.
tutorial.step.intro_kill.title: [Kill]
tutorial.step.intro_kill.desc:
The most basic attack card.

[b]What[/b]: Costs 1 mana. Deals 10 damage to a chosen enemy.

[b]Effect[/b]: Primary damage output. Pairing with Wine greatly increases its power.

[b]When to use[/b]: Strike when the enemy has no Dodge — otherwise damage is blocked.

[b]Type[/b]: Attack card. Boosted by skills and equipment that enhance Kill.
tutorial.step.intro_kill.obj: Click the [Kill] card to attack the enemy
tutorial.step.intro_kill.tips: The target can Dodge your Kill. Strike when they run out of Dodges.
tutorial.step.intro_dodge.title: [Dodge]
tutorial.step.intro_dodge.desc:
The most important defensive card.

[b]What[/b]: Costs 0 mana. Play when targeted by a [Kill] or [Fire Kill] to completely negate damage.

[b]Effect[/b]: Core survival tool. Works against both [Kill] and [Fire Kill].

[b]When to use[/b]: Play immediately when attacked. Note: [Thunder Kill] cannot be Dodged.

[b]Type[/b]: Defense card. Some skills enhance or restrict Dodge.
tutorial.step.intro_dodge.obj: The enemy has attacked! Click [Dodge] to block the damage
tutorial.step.intro_dodge.tips: Always keep at least one Dodge in hand — it's your most basic survival tool.
tutorial.step.intro_fire_kill.title: [Fire Kill]
tutorial.step.intro_fire_kill.desc:
A fire-element attack card.

[b]What[/b]: Costs 2 mana. Deals fire-type damage to the target. The target can Dodge this attack.

[b]Effect[/b]: Compared to regular Kill, gains a fire-element damage bonus when paired with fire-type equipment.

[b]When to use[/b]: When you have fire equipment equipped — deals more damage than regular Kill.

[b]Type[/b]: Attack card (Kill type). Boosted by Kill-enhancing skills and fire gear.
tutorial.step.intro_fire_kill.obj: Click [Fire Kill] to deal fire damage to the enemy
tutorial.step.intro_fire_kill.tips: Fire Kill can still be Dodged — it's [Thunder Kill] that bypasses Dodge. Fire Kill deals bonus fire-type damage with fire gear.
tutorial.step.intro_thunder_kill.title: [Thunder Kill]
tutorial.step.intro_thunder_kill.desc:
A lightning-element attack that bypasses Dodge.

[b]What[/b]: Costs 2 mana. Similar to Kill but deals lightning-type damage.

[b]Effect[/b]: Greatly amplified by lightning-element equipment. The target cannot Dodge this attack.

[b]When to use[/b]: When you have lightning equipment, or when the enemy has many Dodge cards — Thunder Kill pierces through all Dodges.

[b]Type[/b]: Attack card (Kill type). Boosted by lightning skills and gear.
tutorial.step.intro_thunder_kill.obj: Learn how [Thunder Kill] bypasses Dodge and deals lightning damage
tutorial.step.intro_thunder_kill.tips: Thunder Kill cannot be Dodged — it bypasses all [Dodge] cards. Pair with lightning gear for maximum damage.
tutorial.step.intro_peach.title: [Peach]
tutorial.step.intro_peach.desc:
A lifesaving recovery card.

[b]What[/b]: Costs 2 mana. Restores 1 HP, up to your maximum.

[b]Effect[/b]: Sustains your HP through long battles. When HP hits 0 you can play Peach out of turn to survive.

[b]When to use[/b]: When HP is low. Don't waste it at full health.

[b]Type[/b]: Recovery card. Some skills increase the HP restored by Peach.
tutorial.step.intro_peach.tips: Save Peach for when you really need it — wasting it at full HP is a common mistake.
tutorial.step.intro_wine.title: [Wine]
tutorial.step.intro_wine.desc:
A buff card that supercharges your next Kill.

[b]What[/b]: Costs 1 mana. Enhances the next Kill you play this turn: +5 damage, and the target needs an extra Dodge to block it.

[b]Effect[/b]: Major damage boost when paired with Kill. Does not deal damage on its own.

[b]When to use[/b]: When the enemy runs out of Dodges — play Wine then Kill for maximum burst.

[b]Type[/b]: Buff card. Wine boost applies once per turn.
tutorial.step.intro_wine.tips: Wine + Kill is the most basic burst combo — save it for when the enemy can't block.
tutorial.step.intro_steal.title: [Steal]
tutorial.step.intro_steal.desc:
A stratagem card that plunders the enemy.

[b]What[/b]: Costs 1 mana. Takes one card from the target's hand or equipment slot.

[b]Effect[/b]: Weakens the enemy's key gear while gaining resources for yourself.

[b]When to use[/b]: Target must be in attack range. Prioritize stealing weapons or armor.

[b]Type[/b]: Stratagem card. Can be countered by Unassailable.
tutorial.step.intro_steal.tips: Stealing key weapons or armor can completely disrupt the enemy's strategy.
tutorial.step.intro_unassailable.title: [Unassailable]
tutorial.step.intro_unassailable.desc:
An instant counter stratagem.

[b]What[/b]: Costs 0.5 mana. Play at any time to negate one stratagem card's effect.

[b]Effect[/b]: Shuts down the enemy's stratagems. Can chain with the enemy's own Unassailable.

[b]When to use[/b]: When the enemy plays a stratagem that harms you — play before it resolves.

[b]Type[/b]: Stratagem card (instant). No turn restriction — play anytime.
tutorial.step.intro_unassailable.tips: Save it for critical moments — the right timing can completely turn the tide.
tutorial.step.intro_battle_log.title: Battle Log
tutorial.step.intro_battle_log.desc:
The Battle Log records every resolution step in combat.

You can use it to understand:

• The source and calculation of every damage instance
• When skill effects triggered
• Changes to Buffs and DeBuffs
• Why you took a particular hit

When confused about a result, the log almost always explains it.
tutorial.step.intro_battle_log.obj: Check the Battle Log in the center area
tutorial.step.intro_battle_log.tips: Checking the log regularly builds your understanding of complex battle mechanics.
tutorial.step.intro_summary.title: Tutorial Complete!
tutorial.step.intro_summary.desc:
Congratulations — you've mastered all the basic cards!

[b]Core battle loop:[/b]

① Build mana — play [Fee]
② Attack or defend based on the situation
③ Manage your hand carefully for unexpected moments

Skills, equipment, and event systems will further enrich your strategy.

Start your first run and discover your own playstyle!
tutorial.step.intro_summary.tips: Every run has a different character and gear — explore, experiment, and enjoy!

tutorial.step.ui_intro.title: Getting to know the battle screen
tutorial.step.ui_intro.desc:
This is the whole battle screen — every battle from now on will take place here.

First, look at the character panels at the top and bottom of the screen. The top shows the enemy's information, and the bottom shows yours.

Each character panel includes:

[b]HP[/b]: HP represents how much damage a character can still take. Once it drops to 0 or below, the character is on the verge of death.

[b]Fee[/b]: Fee is the most important resource in battle — most cards require fee to play.

[b]Status[/b]: Shows the character's current buffs, debuffs, and control effects.

[b]Skills[/b]: A character's skills are shown here — click to view details.

[b]Equipment[/b]: Any weapons, armor, or accessories the character has equipped are shown here, affecting battle outcomes.

[b]Battle Log[/b]: The center of the screen records every event as it happens each turn — check it any time to see what just occurred.

[b]Action row[/b]: The bottom of the screen is your action row — every card has its own effect, and we'll learn them one by one.
tutorial.step.ui_intro.obj: Click your own portrait, then the enemy's portrait, to view both sides' details.
tutorial.step.ui_intro.tips: Every future battle happens on this same screen — getting familiar with it now will help you later.
tutorial.step.char_detail.title: Character details
tutorial.step.char_detail.desc:
Clicking a character's portrait shows more detailed information.

This includes:

• Current and maximum HP
• Current fee
• Current skills
• Current equipment
• Current buffs and debuffs
• Current special status effects

Make it a habit to check both sides' information during battle.

For example: Does the enemy have a lot of fee? Does the enemy have special skills? Do you have any buffs? All of this affects which card you should play.
tutorial.step.char_detail.obj: Check the enemy's detailed information again.
tutorial.step.char_detail.tips: Making a habit of checking both sides' info will sharpen your decision-making.
tutorial.step.simultaneous_play.title: Choose the card you'll play this turn
tutorial.step.simultaneous_play.desc:
You and the enemy each pick one card in the same turn. Once both sides have chosen, the cards are revealed together and resolved at the same time.

Your play area is below; the enemy's info is above. Both sides' HP and fee update in real time.
tutorial.step.simultaneous_play.obj: Take a look around — no need to play a card yet. Click Continue.
tutorial.step.card_fee.title: This is [Fee] — most cards require fee to play
tutorial.step.card_fee.desc:
[b]What it is[/b]: Playing it immediately grants 1 fee, at no cost.

[b]What it does[/b]: Fee is the most important resource in battle — attacking, defending, and healing mostly depend on it.

[b]When to use it[/b]: When you're low on fee, or want to prepare for next turn, prioritize playing [Fee].

[b]Type[/b]: Resource card.
tutorial.step.card_dodge.title: This is [Dodge] — the most important defensive card
tutorial.step.card_dodge.desc:
[b]What it is[/b]: Costs no fee. Play it when hit by a [Kill] attack to fully block the damage.

[b]What it does[/b]: The core tool for survival, and the key way to stop the enemy's offense.

[b]When to use it[/b]: Play it immediately when the enemy uses a normal [Kill] or [Fire Kill] attack.

[b]Type[/b]: Defensive card.
tutorial.step.card_dodge.obj: The enemy just played [Kill]! Click [Dodge] immediately to defend.
tutorial.step.card_kill.title: This is [Kill] — the most basic attack card
tutorial.step.card_kill.desc:
[b]What it is[/b]: Costs 1 fee, deals 10 damage to the enemy.

[b]What it does[/b]: Your main source of damage, and the card you'll use most often.

[b]When to use it[/b]: When the enemy isn't defending, or is playing a card like [Fee] that can't block an attack.

[b]Type[/b]: Attack card.
tutorial.step.card_kill.obj: The enemy is playing [Fee] — seize the moment and attack with [Kill].
tutorial.step.card_firekill.title: This is [Fire Kill]
tutorial.step.card_firekill.desc:
[b]What it is[/b]: Costs 2 fee, deals 15 damage to the enemy.

[b]What it does[/b]: Higher damage output — great for dealing big damage when the enemy can't defend.

[b]When to use it[/b]: When the enemy is about to use a normal [Kill], [Fire Kill] can counter it.

[b]Type[/b]: Attack card.
tutorial.step.card_firekill.obj: The enemy is about to play [Kill] — play [Fire Kill] immediately.
tutorial.step.card_thunderkill.title: This is [Thunder Kill]
tutorial.step.card_thunderkill.desc:
[b]What it is[/b]: Costs 2 fee, deals 10 damage to the enemy.

[b]What it does[/b]: [Thunder Kill] cannot be blocked by [Dodge] — an important way to break through enemy defense.

[b]When to use it[/b]: When you expect the enemy to use [Dodge] to defend against a normal attack, use [Thunder Kill] instead.

[b]Type[/b]: Attack card.
tutorial.step.card_thunderkill.obj: The enemy is about to play [Dodge] — play [Thunder Kill] immediately.
tutorial.step.counter_round_a.title: Counter Review · Round A
tutorial.step.counter_round_a.desc: [Fire Kill] counters [Kill]. The enemy will play [Kill] this round — answer with [Fire Kill] and your attack lands while theirs doesn't.
tutorial.step.counter_round_b.title: Counter Review · Round B
tutorial.step.counter_round_b.desc: [Kill] counters [Thunder Kill]. The enemy will play [Thunder Kill] this round — answer with [Kill] and your attack lands while theirs doesn't.
tutorial.step.counter_round_c.title: Counter Review · Round C
tutorial.step.counter_round_c.desc: [Thunder Kill] counters [Fire Kill]. The enemy will play [Fire Kill] this round — answer with [Thunder Kill] and your attack lands while theirs doesn't.
tutorial.step.counter_round_c.obj: Play [Thunder Kill] against the enemy's [Fire Kill].
tutorial.step.counter_summary.title: The Counter Cycle
tutorial.step.counter_summary.desc: Fire Kill → counters → Kill → counters → Thunder Kill → counters → Fire Kill: a closed loop. When both sides play cards that counter each other, the countering side deals damage and the countered side doesn't. Base damage still differs (Kill 10, Fire Kill 15, Thunder Kill 10) — countering doesn't change that base number.
tutorial.step.card_counters.title: Kill / Fire Kill / Thunder Kill: The Counter Cycle
tutorial.step.card_counters.desc:
[b]What it is[/b]: Normal [Kill], [Fire Kill], and [Thunder Kill] form a rock-paper-scissors cycle:

[Fire Kill] counters [Kill]
[Kill] counters [Thunder Kill]
[Thunder Kill] counters [Fire Kill]

[b]What it does[/b]: When both sides play attack cards that counter each other, the countering side deals damage and the countered side deals none this time — the outcome is decided purely by this counter relationship, regardless of fee cost or HP.

[b]When to use it[/b]: Watch what kind of attack card the enemy is likely to play, and try to answer with the card that counters it. The three cards don't all deal the same base damage: [Kill] deals 10, [Fire Kill] deals 15, [Thunder Kill] deals 10 — the counter relationship doesn't change these base numbers.
tutorial.step.card_counters.obj: Remember the cycle: Fire Kill beats Kill, Kill beats Thunder Kill, Thunder Kill beats Fire Kill.
tutorial.step.card_counters.tips: [Sure Kill] ignores this cycle entirely — it beats Kill, Fire Kill, and Thunder Kill all the same.
tutorial.step.card_peach.title: This is [Peach] — the most important recovery card
tutorial.step.card_peach.desc:
[b]What it is[/b]: Costs 2 fee, restores 10 HP. If you take one attack this turn, you won't take damage from it.

[b]What it does[/b]: Helps you recover and stay alive when your HP is low.

[b]When to use it[/b]: Most valuable when your HP is low, but can also be played proactively to use this turn's damage-immunity to block an incoming attack.

[b]Type[/b]: Recovery card.
tutorial.step.card_peach.obj: Your HP is already low — play [Peach] right away to heal.
tutorial.step.card_wine.title: This is [Wine] — an enhancement card
tutorial.step.card_wine.desc:
[b]What it is[/b]: Costs 1 fee, grants the [Wine] buff — next turn, all [Kill]-type cards deal increased damage.

[b]What it does[/b]: Doesn't deal damage immediately, but boosts your attack power next turn.

[b]When to use it[/b]: Play it before you plan to attack next turn for higher damage output.

[b]Type[/b]: Enhancement card.
tutorial.step.card_wine.obj: Play [Wine] first to prepare for next turn's attack.
tutorial.step.card_wine_kill.title: Now play [Kill] to feel the wine buff
tutorial.step.card_wine_kill.desc:
[b]Tip[/b]: The [Wine] buff from the previous step is now active — this [Kill] will deal more damage than usual.

[b]Type[/b]: Attack card.
tutorial.step.card_wine_kill.obj: Play [Kill] now to feel the damage boost from the Wine buff.
tutorial.step.card_peach.tips: [Peach] doesn't just heal — it also grants one instance of damage immunity this turn.
tutorial.step.card_unassailable.title: This is [Unassailable] — a special defensive card
tutorial.step.card_unassailable.desc:
[b]What it is[/b]: Costs 0.5 fee and can block enemy trick-card effects.

[b]What it does[/b]: [Dodge] only blocks normal attacks and can't stop trick-card effects — that's when [Unassailable] protects you.

[b]When to use it[/b]: Play it immediately when the enemy launches a trick-card attack.

[b]Type[/b]: Trick card.
tutorial.step.card_unassailable.obj: The enemy is about to launch a trick-card attack — play [Unassailable] immediately to defend.
tutorial.step.final_battle.title: Final Exercise
tutorial.step.final_battle.desc:
Congratulations — you've learned every basic card!

From here on, you won't be told which card to play. Choose the best card based on the enemy's actions.

Remember the most important principles:

• Fee is the most important resource — without it, you can't act.
• A normal [Kill] can attack the enemy.
• [Dodge] blocks normal [Kill] and [Fire Kill].
• [Thunder Kill] cannot be blocked by [Dodge].
• [Peach] restores HP.
• [Wine] boosts your attack next turn.
• [Unassailable] can block special attacks.
tutorial.step.final_battle.obj: Reduce the enemy's HP to 0 to win.
tutorial.step.final_battle.tips: The enemy will randomly play [Fee], [Kill], or [Dodge].

factionfate.shu_fate_peach_wine_unity.de: Playing Wine also counts as playing Peach, and playing Peach also counts as playing Wine.

tutorial.integrated.event.desc: Different choices in an event lead to different outcomes. Some options only appear for certain characters, equipment, or conditions.
tutorial.integrated.map.node_types.title: Map Node Types
tutorial.integrated.map.node_types.desc:
○ Battle: Defeat enemies for a basic reward.
？ Event: Make a choice that may reward or cost you something.
◆ Elite: A tougher fight, usually with a better reward.
☠ Boss: Defeating it advances you to the next chapter.
⛊ Shop: Spend gold on equipment and other goods.
tutorial.integrated.map.node.title: Choose a Map Node
tutorial.integrated.map.node.desc: The map unlocks one node at a time. Click the highlighted node to move forward.
tutorial.integrated.map.power.title: Entering a Node Costs Power
tutorial.integrated.map.power.desc: Most map nodes cost power to enter. If you don't have enough power, you can't enter nodes that require it.
first_time_hint.first_chip.title: You Got a Chip
first_time_hint.first_chip.desc: Chips permanently strengthen your character. Attack, Defense, and Knowledge chips each grant a different bonus — check your current counts in the backpack.
first_time_hint.first_elite.title: Entered an Elite Fight
first_time_hint.first_elite.desc: Elite fights are tougher than normal battles, but usually give better rewards.
first_time_hint.first_boss_sighting.desc: Entering a Boss node costs no power and is always available — defeating this chapter's Boss advances you to the next chapter.
first_time_hint.first_free_explore.title: Free Exploration Started
first_time_hint.first_free_explore.desc: After the elite fight, the map keeps refreshing battle/event/shop nodes you can explore — you can challenge the Boss directly at any time.
first_time_hint.first_skill_trigger.desc: Every character has a unique skill that triggers automatically under certain conditions — check its exact effect on the character select screen.
first_time_hint.first_buff.title: You Gained a Buff
first_time_hint.first_buff.desc: A Buff is a status effect that helps you — check your current Buffs in the character status panel.
first_time_hint.first_debuff.title: You Gained a Debuff
first_time_hint.first_debuff.desc: A Debuff is a status effect that hurts you — check what you're currently affected by in the character status panel.
first_time_hint.first_near_death.title: You Entered Near-Death
first_time_hint.first_near_death.desc: When HP hits 0 you first enter a near-death state — a Peach, Wine, or certain equipment may save you; only a failed rescue ends the run.
first_time_hint.first_forage_spent.title: Forage Was Spent
first_time_hint.first_forage_spent.desc: Running out of forage ends this run — keep an eye on your supply.
first_time_hint.first_temp_hp.title: You Gained Temporary HP
first_time_hint.first_temp_hp.desc: Temporary HP stacks on top of your current HP and can exceed your max — it clears automatically once the battle ends.
first_time_hint.first_special_route.desc: This chapter is on a special route — the enemy and event pools may differ from usual.
first_time_hint.first_faction_fate.title: A Faction Fate Was Rolled
first_time_hint.first_faction_fate.desc: A Faction Fate affects this entire run — check its exact effect on the map screen.
first_time_hint.first_vehicle_shop.title: Entered a Vehicle Shop
first_time_hint.first_vehicle_shop.desc: Vehicle shops sell vehicle-type equipment specifically — spend gold to buy them.
first_time_hint.first_equipment_swap.des: Dragging an item onto an occupied slot swaps them automatically — neither item is lost.

tutorial.meta.step.meta_intro.title: Welcome Beyond the Battlefield
tutorial.meta.step.meta_intro.desc: Beyond combat itself, every run takes place on a map: starting from the chapter's first node and exploring onward until the chapter Boss is defeated.
tutorial.meta.step.meta_map_structure.ti: The Map Is a Chain of Nodes
tutorial.meta.step.meta_map_structure.de: The map is made of a chain of clickable nodes: clearing the current node unlocks the next one. Click an unlocked node to enter it immediately - no need to move a character. Below is Chapter 1's real node order.
tutorial.meta.step.meta_node_types.title: Meet the Node Types
tutorial.meta.step.meta_node_types.desc: ○ Battle node: a normal fight (like the highlighted one - Chapter 1's common enemy here is the Scavenger); ? Event node: choices and encounters; ◆ Elite node: a tougher fight, usually with better rewards; ☠ Boss node: the chapter's final stage.
tutorial.meta.step.meta_after_elite.titl: After the Elite Node: Free Exploration
tutorial.meta.step.meta_after_elite.desc: Defeating the Elite node immediately unlocks the chapter Boss; at the same time, the map generates a fresh batch of free-exploration nodes: battles, events, shops, and so on. Clearing one regenerates a new batch, until you choose to challenge the Boss instead. Click any node below to continue.
tutorial.meta.step.meta_energy.title: Power: The Cost of Entering a Node
tutorial.meta.step.meta_energy.desc: Entering a Battle/Event/Elite node costs power; you can keep exploring until power runs out. Click the button below to try spending some.
tutorial.meta.step.meta_energy_insuffici: When power is too low, nodes that require power are disabled (shown as Insufficient Power); free nodes (like the Boss node, always 0 cost) can still be entered. Click the free node below to continue.
At the start of a run you may roll a Faction Fate; each faction has several possible fates, here's one real example per faction: Wei's Golden Reserve, Shu's Initiative, Wu's Treasure Rack, Qun's Fate Dice. Click any card to see its real effect.

Once rolled, a Faction Fate stays in effect for the entire run. (If you roll Wei · Double Campaign, an extra optional Boss node appears after the elite fight — costs 10 power to challenge, no penalty for skipping.)
tutorial.meta.step.meta_initial_event.ti: Initial Event: Where the Run Begins
tutorial.meta.step.meta_initial_event.de: Every run starts with an initial choice, drawing 3 options from a larger pool. Below is one real combination that can actually appear. Click any option to try it.
The game progresses through chapters, and some chapters have alternate routes (like the Sewer route) or special variants (like Curse Night); available content displays normally. Chapter 4 is currently placeholder content, honestly marked "Available (Placeholder Content)" rather than a plain "Available".
tutorial.meta.step.meta_run_goal.title: The Goal of This Run
tutorial.meta.step.meta_run_goal.desc: Follow the map's chain of nodes, manage your power and resources, defeat the chapter Boss, then move on to the next chapter until every chapter is cleared.
tutorial.meta.step.meta_run_goal.tips: If things get tough, you can always return to the main menu to adjust your character or start over.
tutorial.meta.step.meta_complete.title: Beyond Combat Tutorial Complete
tutorial.meta.step.meta_complete.desc: You now understand the map, power, faction fates, initial events, and chapter structure. Good luck on your real run!
